```{r}
skeleton_data <- read.csv("Data/SkeletonData.csv") %>% dplyr::select(Abs_lat, Genus, Species, SitePair, UrchinID, Condition, TestDiameter, ThicknessCT.um., Porosity, MgCO3, Spine_length, Spine_diameter, Spine_porosity, Jaw_length) %>%
    rename(
         Site = Condition) 



environmental_data <- read.csv("Data/EnvData.csv")

```

# Calculate Omega Mg-Calcite
```{r}
# ==================================================
# Mg-CALCITE SATURATION STATE
# ==================================================

environmental_data <- environmental_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    median_omega_mg_calcite = Om(
      x = 0.12786,
      flag = 8,
      var1 = median_pH,
      var2 = median_TA / 1e6,
      k1k2 = "l",
      kf = "pf",
      ks = "d",
      pHscale = "T",
      b = "u74"
    )$OmegaMgCa_biogenic
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Inspect results
environmental_data %>%
  select(
    Analogue, Site, median_pH, median_TA,
    median_omega_mg_calcite
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```


```{r}
# ---- Merge EnvData and Skeletal Data ---- #
dat_all <- skeleton_data %>%
  left_join(
    environmental_data,
    by = c("SitePair", "Site")) %>%
  mutate(
    Biomineral       = 100 - Porosity,                  
    Biomineral_z     = as.numeric(scale(Biomineral)),
    Thickness_z      = as.numeric(scale(ThicknessCT.um.)),
    SpineDia_z       = as.numeric(scale(Spine_diameter)),
    SpineLen_z       = as.numeric(scale(Spine_length)),
    SpinePor_z       = as.numeric(scale(Spine_porosity)),
    SpineBiomineral  = 100 - Spine_porosity,
    SpineBiomineral_z     = as.numeric(scale(SpineBiomineral)),
    JawLen_z         = as.numeric(scale(Jaw_length)),
    TestDiameter_z = as.numeric(scale(TestDiameter)),
    pH_z = as.numeric(scale(median_pH)),
    pH_var_z = as.numeric(scale(pH_var)),
    Omega_z = as.numeric(scale(median_omega_mg_calcite)),
    Omega_calc_z = as.numeric(scale(mean_omega_calcite)),
    SitePair = factor(SitePair),
    Analogue = factor(Analogue),
    Genus    = factor(Genus)
  )

dat_all$SiteID <- interaction(dat_all$Analogue,
                              dat_all$SitePair,
                              dat_all$Site,
                              drop = TRUE)
```

# pH models
```{r}
# ---- Full code for each, later using functions loop over traits ---- #

# Test Biomineral
model_biom_consistency <- brm(
  Biomineral_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Test Thickness
model_thi_consistency <- brm(
  Thickness_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Jaw Length
model_jaw_len_consistency <- brm(
  JawLen_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Spine Biomineral
model_spine_por_consistency <- brm(
  SpineBiomineral_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Spine Thickness
model_spine_dia_consistency <- brm(
  SpineDia_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Spine Length
model_spine_len_consistency <- brm(
  SpineLen_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + scale(median_pH) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
)

# ---- Extract posterior draws for median pH ---- #
get_pH_draws <- function(model, response_name) {
  as_draws_df(model) %>%
    select(b_scalemedian_pH) %>%   # correct column name from brms
    mutate(response = response_name)
}

draws_all <- bind_rows(
  get_pH_draws(model_biom_consistency,        "Test Biomineral (%)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_thi_consistency,        "Test Thickness (µm)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_spine_por_consistency,  "Spine Biomineral (%)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_spine_dia_consistency,  "Spine Thickness (µm)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_spine_len_consistency,  "Spine Length (mm)"),
  get_pH_draws(model_jaw_len_consistency,    "Jaw Length (mm)")
)

# ---- Summarise posterior (median + 95% & 50% HDI) ---- #
sum_95 <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_scalemedian_pH, .width = 0.95) %>%
  rename(
    median      = b_scalemedian_pH,
    hdi_95_low  = .lower,
    hdi_95_high = .upper
  )

sum_50 <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_scalemedian_pH, .width = 0.50) %>%
  rename(
    hdi_50_low  = .lower,
    hdi_50_high = .upper
  )

effects_sum <- sum_95 %>%
  left_join(sum_50, by = "response")

effects_sum <- effects_sum %>%
  mutate(
    median_flip   = -median,
    hdi_95_low_flip = -hdi_95_high,  
    hdi_95_high_flip = -hdi_95_low,
    hdi_50_low_flip  = -hdi_50_high,
    hdi_50_high_flip = -hdi_50_low
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    seg_color = case_when(
      median_flip > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",  
      median_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE            ~ "#ffc857ff"
    ),
    fill_color = case_when(
      hdi_95_low_flip  > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      hdi_95_high_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE                 ~ "#FFFFFF"
    ),
    response = factor(response, levels = c(
      "Jaw Length (mm)",
      "Spine Length (mm)",
      "Spine Thickness (µm)",
      "Spine Biomineral (%)",
      "Test Thickness (µm)",
      "Test Biomineral (%)"
    ))
  )

# ---- Plot (flip x-axis to show decreasing pH) ---- #
SiteEffects_pH <- ggplot(effects_sum, aes(x = median_flip, y = response)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = hdi_95_low_flip, xend = hdi_95_high_flip, yend = response, color = seg_color),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = hdi_50_low_flip, xend = hdi_50_high_flip, yend = response, color = seg_color),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = fill_color),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(
    x = expression("β (Median pH"[T]*")"),
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


SiteEffects_pH

ggsave(
  "Figures/MainText/pH_MainEffect_plot.svg",
  plot = SiteEffects_pH,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

```

# R2 Statistics
```{r}
models <- list(
  "Test Biomineral Content" = model_biom_consistency,
  "Test Thickness" = model_thi_consistency,
  "Jaw Length" = model_jaw_len_consistency,
  "Spine Biomineral Content" = model_spine_por_consistency,
  "Spine Thickness" = model_spine_dia_consistency,
  "Spine Length" = model_spine_len_consistency
)

r2_results <- lapply(names(models), function(trait){
  
  r2 <- bayes_R2(models[[trait]])
  
  data.frame(
    Trait = trait,
    Estimate = r2[, "Estimate"],
    Est_Error = r2[, "Est.Error"],
    Q2.5 = r2[, "Q2.5"],
    Q97.5 = r2[, "Q97.5"]
  )
})

r2_results_pH_reduced_model <- dplyr::bind_rows(r2_results)

r2_results_pH_reduced_model

write.csv(r2_results_pH_reduced_model, "ResultsTables/r2_results_pH_reduced_model.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Diagnostic plots for pH models
```{r}
color_scheme_set("purple")

save_model_diagnostics <- function(model, model_name, folder){

  
  dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  
  brms_plots <- plot(model)

  posterior_hist  <- brms_plots[[1]]
  posterior_trace <- brms_plots[[2]]

  
  pp <- pp_check(model) +
    ggtitle("Posterior predictive check")

  
  combined <- arrangeGrob(
    posterior_hist,
    posterior_trace,
    pp,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(1, 1, 1.1)
  )

  # Save to chosen folder
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(folder, "/", model_name, "_ALL_diagnostics.png"),
    plot = combined,
    width = 10,
    height = 16,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

models <- list(
  "Test_Biomineral_Content" = model_biom_consistency,
  "Test_Thickness" = model_thi_consistency,
  "Jaw_Length" = model_jaw_len_consistency,
  "Spine_Biomineral_Content" = model_spine_por_consistency,
  "Spine_Thickness" = model_spine_dia_consistency,
  "Spine_Length" = model_spine_len_consistency
)

invisible(
  lapply(names(models), function(name){
    save_model_diagnostics(models[[name]], name,
                           "DiagnosticPlots/pH_models")
  })
)
```

# Sensitivity analysis - pH models
```{r}
# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: EXCLUDING WHITE ISLAND / WHAKAARI
# Outputs:
#   1. Six refitted Bayesian models
#   2. Posterior pH-effect summaries
#   3. Forest plot of pH effects
#   4. Bayesian R2 table
#   5. Model diagnostic plots
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Exclude White Island / Whakaari
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dat_no_whakaari <- dat_all %>%
  filter(
    !grepl(
      "White Island|Whakaari",
      as.character(Analogue),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  droplevels()


# Check exclusions
cat("Original observations:", nrow(dat_all), "\n")
cat("Reduced observations:", nrow(dat_no_whakaari), "\n")
cat(
  "Observations excluded:",
  nrow(dat_all) - nrow(dat_no_whakaari), "\n"
)

cat("\nRemaining analogues:\n")
print(unique(dat_no_whakaari$Analogue))

cat("\nExcluded analogues:\n")
print(
  unique(
    dat_all$Analogue[
      grepl(
        "White Island|Whakaari",
        as.character(dat_all$Analogue),
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )
    ]
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Re-standardise ALL variables using reduced dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dat_no_whakaari <- dat_no_whakaari %>%
  mutate(
    # Skeletal response variables
    Biomineral_z = as.numeric(scale(Biomineral)),
    Thickness_z = as.numeric(scale(ThicknessCT.um.)),
    JawLen_z = as.numeric(scale(Jaw_length)),
    SpineBiomineral_z = as.numeric(scale(SpineBiomineral)),
    SpineDia_z = as.numeric(scale(Spine_diameter)),
    SpineLen_z = as.numeric(scale(Spine_length)),

    # Predictor variables
    median_pH_z = as.numeric(scale(median_pH)),
    TestDiameter_z = as.numeric(scale(TestDiameter))
  )


# Check standardisation
cat("\nStandardised variable means:\n")

print(
  dat_no_whakaari %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        c(
          Biomineral_z,
          Thickness_z,
          JawLen_z,
          SpineBiomineral_z,
          SpineDia_z,
          SpineLen_z,
          median_pH_z,
          TestDiameter_z
        ),
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
)

cat("\nStandardised variable SDs:\n")

print(
  dat_no_whakaari %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        c(
          Biomineral_z,
          Thickness_z,
          JawLen_z,
          SpineBiomineral_z,
          SpineDia_z,
          SpineLen_z,
          median_pH_z,
          TestDiameter_z
        ),
        ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Fit six Bayesian models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Test Biomineral Content
model_biom_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  Biomineral_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Test Thickness
model_thi_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  Thickness_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Jaw Length
model_jaw_len_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  JawLen_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Spine Biomineral Content
model_spine_por_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  SpineBiomineral_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Spine Thickness
model_spine_dia_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  SpineDia_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Spine Length
model_spine_len_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  SpineLen_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract posterior draws for pH effects
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_pH_draws <- function(model, response_name) {

  as_draws_df(model) %>%
    select(b_median_pH_z) %>%
    mutate(response = response_name)

}


draws_all_no_whakaari <- bind_rows(

  get_pH_draws(
    model_biom_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Test Biomineral Content"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_thi_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Test Thickness"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_jaw_len_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Jaw Length"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_spine_por_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Spine Biomineral Content"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_spine_dia_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Spine Thickness"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_spine_len_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Spine Length"
  )

)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Summarise posterior pH effects
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# 95% HDI
sum_95_no_whakaari <- draws_all_no_whakaari %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_median_pH_z, .width = 0.95) %>%
  rename(
    median = b_median_pH_z,
    hdi_95_low = .lower,
    hdi_95_high = .upper
  )


# 50% HDI
sum_50_no_whakaari <- draws_all_no_whakaari %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_median_pH_z, .width = 0.50) %>%
  rename(
    hdi_50_low = .lower,
    hdi_50_high = .upper
  )


# Combine summaries
effects_sum_no_whakaari <- sum_95_no_whakaari %>%
  select(
    response,
    median,
    hdi_95_low,
    hdi_95_high
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sum_50_no_whakaari %>%
      select(
        response,
        hdi_50_low,
        hdi_50_high
      ),
    by = "response"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Prepare effect directions and plot colours
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_sum_no_whakaari <- effects_sum_no_whakaari %>%
  mutate(
    median_flip = -median,
    hdi_95_low_flip = -hdi_95_high,
    hdi_95_high_flip = -hdi_95_low,
    hdi_50_low_flip = -hdi_50_high,
    hdi_50_high_flip = -hdi_50_low
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    seg_color = case_when(
      median_flip > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      median_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE ~ "#ffc857ff"
    ),
    fill_color = case_when(
      hdi_95_low_flip > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      hdi_95_high_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE ~ "#FFFFFF"
    ),
    response = recode(
      response,
      "Test Biomineral Content" = "Test Biomineral (%)",
      "Test Thickness" = "Test Thickness (µm)",
      "Jaw Length" = "Jaw Length (mm)",
      "Spine Biomineral Content" = "Spine Biomineral (%)",
      "Spine Thickness" = "Spine Thickness (µm)",
      "Spine Length" = "Spine Length (mm)"
    ),
    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = c(
        "Jaw Length (mm)",
        "Spine Length (mm)",
        "Spine Thickness (µm)",
        "Spine Biomineral (%)",
        "Test Thickness (µm)",
        "Test Biomineral (%)"
      )
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot posterior pH effects
# ------------------------------------------------------------

SiteEffects_pH_no_whakaari <- ggplot(
  effects_sum_no_whakaari,
  aes(x = median_flip, y = response)
) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = hdi_95_low_flip,
      xend = hdi_95_high_flip,
      yend = response,
      color = seg_color
    ),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = hdi_50_low_flip,
      xend = hdi_50_high_flip,
      yend = response,
      color = seg_color
    ),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(fill = fill_color),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +

  labs(
    x = expression("β (Median pH"[T]*")"),
    y = ""
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +

  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      color = "black"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


# Display plot
print(SiteEffects_pH_no_whakaari)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save posterior effect plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(
  "Figures/Supplementary",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(
    "Figures/Supplementary/",
    "pH_MainEffect_plot_excluding_WhiteIsland.svg"
  ),
  plot = SiteEffects_pH_no_whakaari,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5,
  device = "svg"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Calculate Bayesian R2
# ------------------------------------------------------------

models_no_whakaari <- list(

  "Test Biomineral Content" =
    model_biom_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Test Thickness" =
    model_thi_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Jaw Length" =
    model_jaw_len_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Spine Biomineral Content" =
    model_spine_por_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Spine Thickness" =
    model_spine_dia_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Spine Length" =
    model_spine_len_consistency_no_whakaari

)


r2_results_no_whakaari <- lapply(
  names(models_no_whakaari),
  function(trait) {

    r2 <- bayes_R2(models_no_whakaari[[trait]])

    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      Estimate = r2[, "Estimate"],
      Est_Error = r2[, "Est.Error"],
      Q2.5 = r2[, "Q2.5"],
      Q97.5 = r2[, "Q97.5"]
    )

  }
)


r2_results_pH_no_whakaari <- bind_rows(
  r2_results_no_whakaari
)


# Display R2 results
print(r2_results_pH_no_whakaari)


# Save R2 results

  r2_results_pH_no_whakaari,
  "ResultsTables/r2_results_pH_excluding_WhiteIsland.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Save model diagnostics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

color_scheme_set("purple")


save_model_diagnostics <- function(
  model,
  model_name,
  folder
) {

  dir.create(
    folder,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  brms_plots <- plot(model)

  posterior_hist <- brms_plots[[1]]
  posterior_trace <- brms_plots[[2]]

  pp <- pp_check(model) +
    ggtitle("Posterior predictive check")

  combined <- arrangeGrob(
    posterior_hist,
    posterior_trace,
    pp,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(1, 1, 1.1)
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      folder,
      "/",
      model_name,
      "_ALL_diagnostics.png"
    ),
    plot = combined,
    width = 10,
    height = 16,
    dpi = 300
  )

}


# Save diagnostics for all six models
invisible(
  lapply(
    names(models_no_whakaari),
    function(name) {

      save_model_diagnostics(
        models_no_whakaari[[name]],
        name,
        "DiagnosticPlots/pH_models/NoWhiteIsland"
      )

    }
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Save posterior effect summaries
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  effects_sum_no_whakaari,
  "ResultsTables/pH_effects_excluding_WhiteIsland.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Print final results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n\n============================================\n")
cat("SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: EXCLUDING WHITE ISLAND\n")
cat("============================================\n\n")

cat("Posterior pH-effect summaries:\n")
print(effects_sum_no_whakaari)

cat("\nBayesian R2 results:\n")
print(r2_results_pH_no_whakaari)
```

# Plot results for all predictors (Test Diameter, median pH, pH variability)
```{r}

# ============================================================
# EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS FOR ALL THREE PREDICTORS
# ============================================================
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Collect models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

models_pH_med_var <- list(
  "Test Biomineral (%)" = model_biom_pH_med_var,
  "Test Thickness (µm)" = model_thi_pH_med_var,
  "Spine Biomineral (%)" = model_spine_por_pH_med_var,
  "Spine Thickness (µm)" = model_spine_dia_pH_med_var,
  "Spine Length (mm)" = model_spine_len_pH_med_var,
  "Jaw Length (mm)" = model_jaw_len_pH_med_var
)

response_order <- c(
  "Jaw Length (mm)",
  "Spine Length (mm)",
  "Spine Thickness (µm)",
  "Spine Biomineral (%)",
  "Test Thickness (µm)",
  "Test Biomineral (%)"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract posterior draws
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_effect_draws <- function(model_list, parameter, predictor) {

  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(model_list), function(response_name) {

      draws <- as_draws_df(model_list[[response_name]])

      tibble(
        effect = draws[[parameter]],
        response = response_name,
        predictor = predictor
      )

    })
  )
}


# Extract test diameter

draws_test_diameter <- get_effect_draws(
  models_pH_med_var,
  "b_scaleTestDiameter",
  "Test diameter"
)


# Extract median pHT and reverse coefficient signs
# Positive values now represent higher trait values
# associated with decreasing median pHT.

draws_median_pH <- get_effect_draws(
  models_pH_med_var,
  "b_scalemedian_pH",
  "Decreasing median pHT"
) %>%
  mutate(effect = -effect)


# Extract pHT variability (conditional on median pHT)

draws_pH_var <- get_effect_draws(
  models_pH_med_var,
  "b_scalepH_var",
  "pHT variability"
)


# Combine all three predictors

draws_all_effects <- bind_rows(
  draws_test_diameter,
  draws_median_pH,
  draws_pH_var
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Summarise posterior distributions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_summary <- draws_all_effects %>%
  group_by(predictor, response) %>%
  median_hdi(
    effect,
    .width = c(0.95, 0.50)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Separate 95% and 50% HDIs

effects_95 <- effects_summary %>%
  filter(.width == 0.95) %>%
  select(
    predictor,
    response,
    median = effect,
    hdi_95_low = .lower,
    hdi_95_high = .upper
  )

effects_50 <- effects_summary %>%
  filter(.width == 0.50) %>%
  select(
    predictor,
    response,
    hdi_50_low = .lower,
    hdi_50_high = .upper
  )


# Combine summaries and assign colours

effects_plot_data <- effects_95 %>%
  left_join(
    effects_50,
    by = c("predictor", "response")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = response_order
    ),

    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = c(
        "Test diameter",
        "Decreasing median pHT",
        "pHT variability"
      )
    ),

    # Colour based on posterior median

    seg_color = case_when(
      median > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      median < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE ~ "#ffc857ff"
    ),

    # White points where 95% HDI overlaps zero

    fill_color = case_when(
      hdi_95_low > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      hdi_95_high < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE ~ "#FFFFFF"
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Function to generate each coefficient panel
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_effect_panel <- function(data, predictor, x_label) {

  ggplot(
    filter(data, as.character(predictor) == !!predictor),
    aes(x = median, y = response)
  ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = hdi_95_low,
        xend = hdi_95_high,
        yend = response,
        color = seg_color
      ),
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = hdi_50_low,
        xend = hdi_50_high,
        yend = response,
        color = seg_color
      ),
      linewidth = 2
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = fill_color),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = ""
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        color = "black"
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Generate three panels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_test_diameter <- plot_effect_panel(
  effects_plot_data,
  "Test diameter",
  expression(beta ~ "(Test diameter)")
)

plot_median_pH <- plot_effect_panel(
  effects_plot_data,
  "Decreasing median pHT",
  expression(beta ~ "(Median pH"[T]*")")
)

plot_pH_var <- plot_effect_panel(
  effects_plot_data,
  "pHT variability",
  expression(beta ~ "(pH"[T] ~ "variability)")
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Combine using patchwork
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined_effects_plot <- (
  plot_test_diameter +
  plot_median_pH +
  plot_pH_var
) +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 3,
    widths = c(1, 1, 1)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A"
  )


combined_effects_plot


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save figure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  "Figures/MainText/pH_med_var_ThreePredictorEffects.svg",
  plot = combined_effects_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
  "Test Thickness (µm)" = model_thi_pH_med_var,
  "Spine Biomineral (%)" = model_spine_por_pH_med_var,
  "Spine Thickness (µm)" = model_spine_dia_pH_med_var,
  "Spine Length (mm)" = model_spine_len_pH_med_var,
  "Jaw Length (mm)" = model_jaw_len_pH_med_var
)

r2_results <- lapply(names(models), function(trait){
  
  r2 <- bayes_R2(models[[trait]])
  
  data.frame(
    Trait = trait,
    Estimate = r2[, "Estimate"],
    Est_Error = r2[, "Est.Error"],
    Q2.5 = r2[, "Q2.5"],
    Q97.5 = r2[, "Q97.5"]
  )
})

r2_results_ph_med_var_model <- dplyr::bind_rows(r2_results)

write.csv(r2_results_ph_med_var_model, "ResultsTables/r2_results_ph_med_var_model.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Summarise posterior estimates
```{r}

# ==================================================
# EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS FOR ALL THREE PREDICTORS
# EFFECTS REPORTED IN ORIGINAL TRAIT UNITS
# ==================================================

# ==================================================
# 1. DEFINE MODELS
# ==================================================

models_pH_med_var_original <- list(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = model_biom_pH_med_var,
  "Test thickness (µm)" = model_thi_pH_med_var,
  "Jaw length (mm)" = model_jaw_len_pH_med_var,
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = model_spine_por_pH_med_var,
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = model_spine_dia_pH_med_var,
  "Spine length (mm)" = model_spine_len_pH_med_var
)


# ==================================================
# 2. DEFINE ORIGINAL TRAIT VARIABLES
# ==================================================

trait_variables_original <- c(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = "Biomineral",
  "Test thickness (µm)" = "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw length (mm)" = "Jaw_length",
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine length (mm)" = "Spine_length"
)


# ==================================================
# 3. DEFINE STANDARDISED RESPONSE VARIABLES
# ==================================================

response_variables_z <- c(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = "Biomineral_z",
  "Test thickness (µm)" = "Thickness_z",
  "Jaw length (mm)" = "JawLen_z",
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = "SpineBiomineral_z",
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = "SpineDia_z",
  "Spine length (mm)" = "SpineLen_z"
)


# ==================================================
# 4. CALCULATE ORIGINAL TRAIT SDs
# ==================================================

trait_sd_original <- sapply(
  trait_variables_original,
  function(trait) {
    sd(dat_all[[trait]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
)

# Convert spine diameter SD from mm to µm
trait_sd_original["Spine thickness (µm)"] <-
  trait_sd_original["Spine thickness (µm)"] * 1000

trait_sd_original


# ==================================================
# 5. VERIFY RESPONSE STANDARDISATION
# ==================================================
# The z-responses should have SD approximately 1.
# Their original-scale SDs must correspond to the
# raw trait SDs used during standardisation.

response_sd_z <- sapply(
  response_variables_z,
  function(response) {
    sd(dat_all[[response]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
)

print(response_sd_z)

# Stop if response variables are not properly standardised
if (any(abs(response_sd_z - 1) > 0.01)) {
  warning(
    "At least one response variable is not standardised ",
    "to SD approximately 1. Check the response scaling."
  )
}


# ==================================================
# 6. DEFINE MODEL PARAMETERS
# ==================================================

parameters_pH_med_var_original <- c(
  "b_scaleTestDiameter" = "Test diameter",
  "b_scalemedian_pH" = "Decreasing median pHT",
  "b_scalepH_var" = "pHT variability"
)


# ==================================================
# 7. EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS
#    AND BACK-TRANSFORM TO ORIGINAL TRAIT UNITS
# ==================================================

extract_all_draws_original <- function(
    model,
    response_name
) {

  draws <- as_draws_df(model)

  # SD of original response in final reporting units
  response_sd <- trait_sd_original[[response_name]]

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      names(parameters_pH_med_var_original),
      function(param) {

        effect <- draws[[param]]

        # Reverse median pHT coefficient
        # to represent decreasing median pHT
        if (param == "b_scalemedian_pH") {
          effect <- -effect
        }

        # Convert standardised response effect
        # into original trait measurement units
        effect_original <- effect * response_sd

        tibble(
          response = response_name,
          predictor =
            parameters_pH_med_var_original[[param]],
          effect = effect_original
        )

      }
    )
  )
}


# ==================================================
# 8. EXTRACT DRAWS FROM ALL SIX MODELS
# ==================================================

draws_all_pH_med_var_original <- bind_rows(

  lapply(
    names(models_pH_med_var_original),

    function(response_name) {

      extract_all_draws_original(
        models_pH_med_var_original[[response_name]],
        response_name
      )

    }
  )

)


# ==================================================
# 9. SUMMARISE POSTERIOR
#    MEAN AND 95% CREDIBLE INTERVAL
# ==================================================

effects_table_pH_models_original <-

  draws_all_pH_med_var_original %>%

  group_by(predictor, response) %>%

  summarise(
    Mean = mean(effect),
    `2.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    `97.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==================================================
# 10. CREATE WIDE TABLE
# ==================================================

effects_table_pH_models_original_wide <-

  effects_table_pH_models_original %>%

  mutate(

    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = c(
        "Test diameter",
        "Decreasing median pHT",
        "pHT variability"
      )
    ),

    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = c(
        "Test biomineral (%)",
        "Test thickness (µm)",
        "Jaw length (mm)",
        "Spine biomineral (%)",
        "Spine thickness (µm)",
        "Spine length (mm)"
      )
    )

  ) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = response,
    values_from = c(Mean, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
    names_glue = "{response}_{.value}"
  ) %>%

  arrange(predictor) %>%

  select(

    predictor,

    `Test biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Test thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Jaw length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Spine thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Spine length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine length (mm)_97.5%`

  ) %>%

  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 3)
    )
  )


# ==================================================
# 11. INSPECT TABLE
# ==================================================

effects_table_pH_models_original_wide


# ==================================================
# 12. SAVE TABLE
# ==================================================

write.csv(
  effects_table_pH_models_original_wide,
  "ResultsTables/effects_table_pH_models_original_units.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Diagnostic plots for pH models
```{r}
color_scheme_set("purple")

save_model_diagnostics <- function(model, model_name, folder){

  dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Replace problematic characters in filenames
  safe_name <- gsub("%", "percent", model_name)
  safe_name <- gsub("[µ]", "u", safe_name)
  safe_name <- gsub("[()]", "", safe_name)
  safe_name <- gsub(" ", "_", safe_name)

  brms_plots <- plot(model)

  posterior_hist  <- brms_plots[[1]]
  posterior_trace <- brms_plots[[2]]

  pp <- pp_check(model) +
    ggtitle("Posterior predictive check")

  combined <- arrangeGrob(
    posterior_hist,
    posterior_trace,
    pp,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(1, 1, 1.1)
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(folder, paste0(safe_name, "_ALL_diagnostics.png")),
    plot = combined,
    width = 10,
    height = 16,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

models <- list(
  "Test Biomineral (%)" = model_biom_pH_med_var,
  "Test Thickness (µm)" = model_thi_pH_med_var,
  "Spine Biomineral (%)" = model_spine_por_pH_med_var,
  "Spine Thickness (µm)" = model_spine_dia_pH_med_var,
  "Spine Length (mm)" = model_spine_len_pH_med_var,
  "Jaw Length (mm)" = model_jaw_len_pH_med_var
)

invisible(
  lapply(names(models), function(name){
    save_model_diagnostics(models[[name]], name,
                           "DiagnosticPlots/pH_models")
  })
)
```

# Sensitivity analysis - pH models - no White Island / Whakaari
```{r}
# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: EXCLUDING WHITE ISLAND / WHAKAARI
# Outputs:
#   1. Six refitted Bayesian models
#   2. Posterior pH-effect summaries
#   3. Forest plot of pH effects
#   4. Bayesian R2 table
#   5. Model diagnostic plots
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Exclude White Island / Whakaari
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dat_no_whakaari <- dat_all %>%
  filter(
    !grepl(
      "White Island|Whakaari",
      as.character(Analogue),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  droplevels()


# Check exclusions
cat("Original observations:", nrow(dat_all), "\n")
cat("Reduced observations:", nrow(dat_no_whakaari), "\n")
cat(
  "Observations excluded:",
  nrow(dat_all) - nrow(dat_no_whakaari), "\n"
)

cat("\nRemaining analogues:\n")
print(unique(dat_no_whakaari$Analogue))

cat("\nExcluded analogues:\n")
print(
  unique(
    dat_all$Analogue[
      grepl(
        "White Island|Whakaari",
        as.character(dat_all$Analogue),
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )
    ]
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Re-standardise ALL variables using reduced dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dat_no_whakaari <- dat_no_whakaari %>%
  mutate(
    # Skeletal response variables
    Biomineral_z = as.numeric(scale(Biomineral)),
    Thickness_z = as.numeric(scale(ThicknessCT.um.)),
    JawLen_z = as.numeric(scale(Jaw_length)),
    SpineBiomineral_z = as.numeric(scale(SpineBiomineral)),
    SpineDia_z = as.numeric(scale(Spine_diameter)),
    SpineLen_z = as.numeric(scale(Spine_length)),

    # Predictor variables
    median_pH_z = as.numeric(scale(median_pH)),
    TestDiameter_z = as.numeric(scale(TestDiameter))
  )


# Check standardisation
cat("\nStandardised variable means:\n")

print(
  dat_no_whakaari %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        c(
          Biomineral_z,
          Thickness_z,
          JawLen_z,
          SpineBiomineral_z,
          SpineDia_z,
          SpineLen_z,
          median_pH_z,
          TestDiameter_z
        ),
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
)

cat("\nStandardised variable SDs:\n")

print(
  dat_no_whakaari %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        c(
          Biomineral_z,
          Thickness_z,
          JawLen_z,
          SpineBiomineral_z,
          SpineDia_z,
          SpineLen_z,
          median_pH_z,
          TestDiameter_z
        ),
        ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Fit six Bayesian models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Test Biomineral Content
model_biom_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  Biomineral_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Test Thickness
model_thi_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  Thickness_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Jaw Length
model_jaw_len_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  JawLen_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Spine Biomineral Content
model_spine_por_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  SpineBiomineral_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Spine Thickness
model_spine_dia_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  SpineDia_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# Spine Length
model_spine_len_consistency_no_whakaari <- brm(
  SpineLen_z ~ TestDiameter_z + median_pH_z + pH_var_z +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_no_whakaari,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract posterior draws for pH effects
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_pH_draws <- function(model, response_name) {

  as_draws_df(model) %>%
    select(b_median_pH_z) %>%
    mutate(response = response_name)

}


draws_all_no_whakaari <- bind_rows(

  get_pH_draws(
    model_biom_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Test Biomineral Content"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_thi_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Test Thickness"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_jaw_len_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Jaw Length"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_spine_por_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Spine Biomineral Content"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_spine_dia_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Spine Thickness"
  ),

  get_pH_draws(
    model_spine_len_consistency_no_whakaari,
    "Spine Length"
  )

)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Summarise posterior pH effects
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# 95% HDI
sum_95_no_whakaari <- draws_all_no_whakaari %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_median_pH_z, .width = 0.95) %>%
  rename(
    median = b_median_pH_z,
    hdi_95_low = .lower,
    hdi_95_high = .upper
  )


# 50% HDI
sum_50_no_whakaari <- draws_all_no_whakaari %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_median_pH_z, .width = 0.50) %>%
  rename(
    hdi_50_low = .lower,
    hdi_50_high = .upper
  )


# Combine summaries
effects_sum_no_whakaari <- sum_95_no_whakaari %>%
  select(
    response,
    median,
    hdi_95_low,
    hdi_95_high
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sum_50_no_whakaari %>%
      select(
        response,
        hdi_50_low,
        hdi_50_high
      ),
    by = "response"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Prepare effect directions and plot colours
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_sum_no_whakaari <- effects_sum_no_whakaari %>%
  mutate(
    median_flip = -median,
    hdi_95_low_flip = -hdi_95_high,
    hdi_95_high_flip = -hdi_95_low,
    hdi_50_low_flip = -hdi_50_high,
    hdi_50_high_flip = -hdi_50_low
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    seg_color = case_when(
      median_flip > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      median_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE ~ "#ffc857ff"
    ),
    fill_color = case_when(
      hdi_95_low_flip > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      hdi_95_high_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE ~ "#FFFFFF"
    ),
    response = recode(
      response,
      "Test Biomineral Content" = "Test Biomineral (%)",
      "Test Thickness" = "Test Thickness (µm)",
      "Jaw Length" = "Jaw Length (mm)",
      "Spine Biomineral Content" = "Spine Biomineral (%)",
      "Spine Thickness" = "Spine Thickness (µm)",
      "Spine Length" = "Spine Length (mm)"
    ),
    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = c(
        "Jaw Length (mm)",
        "Spine Length (mm)",
        "Spine Thickness (µm)",
        "Spine Biomineral (%)",
        "Test Thickness (µm)",
        "Test Biomineral (%)"
      )
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot posterior pH effects
# ------------------------------------------------------------

SiteEffects_pH_no_whakaari <- ggplot(
  effects_sum_no_whakaari,
  aes(x = median_flip, y = response)
) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = hdi_95_low_flip,
      xend = hdi_95_high_flip,
      yend = response,
      color = seg_color
    ),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = hdi_50_low_flip,
      xend = hdi_50_high_flip,
      yend = response,
      color = seg_color
    ),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(fill = fill_color),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +

  labs(
    x = expression("β (Median pH"[T]*")"),
    y = ""
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +

  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      color = "black"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


# Display plot
print(SiteEffects_pH_no_whakaari)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save posterior effect plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(
  "Figures/Supplementary",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(
    "Figures/Supplementary/",
    "pH_MainEffect_plot_excluding_WhiteIsland.svg"
  ),
  plot = SiteEffects_pH_no_whakaari,
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5,
  device = "svg"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Calculate Bayesian R2
# ------------------------------------------------------------

models_no_whakaari <- list(

  "Test Biomineral Content" =
    model_biom_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Test Thickness" =
    model_thi_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Jaw Length" =
    model_jaw_len_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Spine Biomineral Content" =
    model_spine_por_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Spine Thickness" =
    model_spine_dia_consistency_no_whakaari,

  "Spine Length" =
    model_spine_len_consistency_no_whakaari

)


r2_results_no_whakaari <- lapply(
  names(models_no_whakaari),
  function(trait) {

    r2 <- bayes_R2(models_no_whakaari[[trait]])

    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      Estimate = r2[, "Estimate"],
      Est_Error = r2[, "Est.Error"],
      Q2.5 = r2[, "Q2.5"],
      Q97.5 = r2[, "Q97.5"]
    )

  }
)


r2_results_pH_no_whakaari <- bind_rows(
  r2_results_no_whakaari
)


# Display R2 results
print(r2_results_pH_no_whakaari)


# Save R2 results
write.csv(
  r2_results_pH_no_whakaari,
  "ResultsTables/r2_results_pH_excluding_WhiteIsland.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Save model diagnostics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

color_scheme_set("purple")


save_model_diagnostics <- function(
  model,
  model_name,
  folder
) {

  dir.create(
    folder,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  brms_plots <- plot(model)

  posterior_hist <- brms_plots[[1]]
  posterior_trace <- brms_plots[[2]]

  pp <- pp_check(model) +
    ggtitle("Posterior predictive check")

  combined <- arrangeGrob(
    posterior_hist,
    posterior_trace,
    pp,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(1, 1, 1.1)
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      folder,
      "/",
      model_name,
      "_ALL_diagnostics.png"
    ),
    plot = combined,
    width = 10,
    height = 16,
    dpi = 300
  )

}


# Save diagnostics for all six models
invisible(
  lapply(
    names(models_no_whakaari),
    function(name) {

      save_model_diagnostics(
        models_no_whakaari[[name]],
        name,
        "DiagnosticPlots/pH_models/NoWhiteIsland"
      )

    }
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Save posterior effect summaries
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  effects_sum_no_whakaari,
  "ResultsTables/pH_effects_excluding_WhiteIsland.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Print final results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n\n============================================\n")
cat("SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: EXCLUDING WHITE ISLAND\n")
cat("============================================\n\n")

cat("Posterior pH-effect summaries:\n")
print(effects_sum_no_whakaari)

cat("\nBayesian R2 results:\n")
print(r2_results_pH_no_whakaari)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================

# Collect sensitivity models

models_no_whakaari <- list(

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract posterior draws

get_effect_draws_no_whakaari <- function(
    model_list,
    parameter,
    predictor
) {

  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(model_list), function(response_name) {

      draws <- as_draws_df(model_list[[response_name]])

      tibble(
        effect = draws[[parameter]],
        response = response_name,
        predictor = predictor
      )

    })
  )
}


# Test diameter

draws_test_diameter_no_whakaari <-
  get_effect_draws_no_whakaari(
    models_no_whakaari,
    "b_TestDiameter_z",
    "Test diameter"
  )


# Median pHT
# Reverse coefficients so positive effects represent
# higher trait values associated with decreasing median pHT.

draws_median_pH_no_whakaari <-
  get_effect_draws_no_whakaari(
    models_no_whakaari,
    "b_median_pH_z",
    "Median pHT"
  ) %>%
  mutate(effect = -effect)


# pHT variability

draws_pH_var_no_whakaari <-
  get_effect_draws_no_whakaari(
    models_no_whakaari,
    "b_pH_var_z",
    "pHT variability"
  )


# Combine all predictors

draws_all_effects_no_whakaari <- bind_rows(
  draws_test_diameter_no_whakaari,
  draws_median_pH_no_whakaari,
  draws_pH_var_no_whakaari
)


# ============================================================
# 5. SUMMARISE POSTERIOR DISTRIBUTIONS
# ============================================================

effects_summary_no_whakaari <-
  draws_all_effects_no_whakaari %>%
  group_by(predictor, response) %>%
  median_hdi(
    effect,
    .width = c(0.95, 0.50)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Separate 95% and 50% HDIs

effects_95_no_whakaari <-
  effects_summary_no_whakaari %>%
  filter(.width == 0.95) %>%
  select(
    predictor,
    response,
    median = effect,
    hdi_95_low = .lower,
    hdi_95_high = .upper
  )


effects_50_no_whakaari <-
  effects_summary_no_whakaari %>%
  filter(.width == 0.50) %>%
  select(
    predictor,
    response,
    hdi_50_low = .lower,
    hdi_50_high = .upper
  )


# Combine summaries and assign colours

effects_plot_data_no_whakaari <-
  effects_95_no_whakaari %>%
  left_join(
    effects_50_no_whakaari,
    by = c("predictor", "response")
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = response_order_no_whakaari
    ),

    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = c(
        "Test diameter",
        "Median pHT",
        "pHT variability"
      )
    ),

    # Colour based on posterior median

    seg_color = case_when(
      median > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      median < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE ~ "#ffc857ff"
    ),

    # White points where 95% HDI overlaps zero

    fill_color = case_when(
      hdi_95_low > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      hdi_95_high < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE ~ "#FFFFFF"
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. FUNCTION TO GENERATE EACH COEFFICIENT PANEL
# ============================================================

plot_effect_panel_no_whakaari <- function(
    data,
    predictor,
    x_label
) {

  ggplot(
    filter(data, as.character(predictor) == !!predictor),
    aes(x = median, y = response)
  ) +

    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = hdi_95_low,
        xend = hdi_95_high,
        yend = response,
        color = seg_color
      ),
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +

    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = hdi_50_low,
        xend = hdi_50_high,
        yend = response,
        color = seg_color
      ),
      linewidth = 2
    ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(fill = fill_color),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_fill_identity() +

    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = ""
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +

    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        color = "black"
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}


# ============================================================
# 7. GENERATE THREE PANELS
# ============================================================

plot_test_diameter_no_whakaari <-
  plot_effect_panel_no_whakaari(
    effects_plot_data_no_whakaari,
    "Test diameter",
    expression(beta ~ "(Test diameter)")
  )


plot_median_pH_no_whakaari <-
  plot_effect_panel_no_whakaari(
    effects_plot_data_no_whakaari,
    "Median pHT",
    expression(beta ~ "(Median pH"[T]*")")
  )


plot_pH_var_no_whakaari <-
  plot_effect_panel_no_whakaari(
    effects_plot_data_no_whakaari,
    "pHT variability",
    expression(beta ~ "(pH"[T] ~ "variability)")
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. COMBINE THREE PANELS
# ============================================================

combined_effects_plot_no_whakaari <- (

  plot_test_diameter_no_whakaari +
  plot_median_pH_no_whakaari +
  plot_pH_var_no_whakaari

) +

  plot_layout(
    ncol = 3,
    widths = c(1, 1, 1)
  ) +

  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A"
  )


# Display figure

combined_effects_plot_no_whakaari


# ============================================================
# 9. SAVE FIGURE
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  "Figures/Supplementary/WhiteIsland_ThreePredictorEffects.svg",
  plot = combined_effects_plot_no_whakaari,
  width = 18,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Extract posterior means
```{r}
# ==================================================
# EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS FOR ALL THREE PREDICTORS
# EXCLUDING WHITE ISLAND / WHAKAARI
# BACK-TRANSFORMED TO ORIGINAL TRAIT UNITS
# ==================================================

library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)


# ==================================================
# 1. DEFINE MODELS
# ==================================================

models_pH_med_var_no_whakaari <- list(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = model_biom_consistency_no_whakaari,
  "Test thickness (µm)" = model_thi_consistency_no_whakaari,
  "Jaw length (mm)" = model_jaw_len_consistency_no_whakaari,
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = model_spine_por_consistency_no_whakaari,
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = model_spine_dia_consistency_no_whakaari,
  "Spine length (mm)" = model_spine_len_consistency_no_whakaari
)


# ==================================================
# 2. DEFINE RAW TRAIT VARIABLES AND SDs
# ==================================================

trait_variables_no_whakaari <- c(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = "Biomineral",
  "Test thickness (µm)" = "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw length (mm)" = "Jaw_length",
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine length (mm)" = "Spine_length"
)


# Calculate SDs from the dataset used for the
# White Island-exclusion models

trait_sd_no_whakaari <- sapply(
  trait_variables_no_whakaari,
  function(x) sd(dat_no_whakaari[[x]], na.rm = TRUE)
)


# Spine diameter is stored in mm but reported in µm

trait_sd_no_whakaari["Spine thickness (µm)"] <-
  trait_sd_no_whakaari["Spine thickness (µm)"] * 1000


# Inspect SDs used for back-transformation

trait_sd_no_whakaari


# ==================================================
# 3. DEFINE MODEL PARAMETERS AND LABELS
# ==================================================

parameters_no_whakaari <- c(
  "b_TestDiameter_z" = "Test diameter",
  "b_median_pH_z" = "Median pHT",
  "b_pH_var_z" = "pHT variability"
)


# ==================================================
# 4. EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS AND BACK-TRANSFORM
# ==================================================

extract_all_draws_no_whakaari <- function(
    model,
    response_name
) {

  draws <- as_draws_df(model)

  response_sd <- trait_sd_no_whakaari[[response_name]]

  # Check that all requested parameters are present

  missing_parameters <- setdiff(
    names(parameters_no_whakaari),
    names(draws)
  )

  if (length(missing_parameters) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing parameters for ", response_name, ": ",
      paste(missing_parameters, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(parameters_no_whakaari), function(param) {

      effect <- draws[[param]]

      # Reverse median pHT coefficient to represent
      # a one SD decrease in median pHT

      if (param == "b_median_pH_z") {
        effect <- -effect
      }

      # Back-transform from SD(response) to
      # original trait units

      effect <- effect * response_sd

      tibble(
        response = response_name,
        predictor = parameters_no_whakaari[[param]],
        effect = effect
      )

    })
  )
}


draws_all_no_whakaari_three_predictors <- bind_rows(

  lapply(
    names(models_pH_med_var_no_whakaari),
    function(response_name) {

      extract_all_draws_no_whakaari(
        models_pH_med_var_no_whakaari[[response_name]],
        response_name
      )

    }
  )

)


# ==================================================
# 5. SUMMARISE POSTERIOR
# MEAN AND 95% CREDIBLE INTERVAL
# ==================================================

effects_table_pH_no_whakaari <-
  draws_all_no_whakaari_three_predictors %>%

  group_by(predictor, response) %>%

  summarise(
    Mean = mean(effect),
    `2.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    `97.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==================================================
# 6. CREATE WIDE TABLE
# ==================================================

effects_table_pH_no_whakaari_wide <-

  effects_table_pH_no_whakaari %>%

  mutate(
    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = c(
        "Test diameter",
        "Median pHT",
        "pHT variability"
      )
    ),

    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = c(
        "Test biomineral (%)",
        "Test thickness (µm)",
        "Jaw length (mm)",
        "Spine biomineral (%)",
        "Spine thickness (µm)",
        "Spine length (mm)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = response,
    values_from = c(Mean, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
    names_glue = "{response}_{.value}"
  ) %>%

  arrange(predictor) %>%

  select(
    predictor,

    `Test biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Test thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Jaw length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Spine thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Spine length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine length (mm)_97.5%`
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 3)
    )
  )


# ==================================================
# 7. INSPECT TABLE
# ==================================================

effects_table_pH_no_whakaari_wide


# ==================================================
# 8. SAVE TABLE
# ==================================================

write.csv(
  effects_table_pH_no_whakaari_wide,
  "ResultsTables/effects_table_pH_models_excluding_WhiteIsland_original_units.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
# ---- Extract posterior draws for Omega Mg-Calcite ---- #
get_omega_draws <- function(model, response_name) {
  as_draws_df(model) %>%
    select(b_Omega_z) %>%
    mutate(response = response_name)
}

draws_all <- bind_rows(
  get_omega_draws(model_biom_consistency_omega, "Test Biomineral (%)"),
  get_omega_draws(model_thi_consistency_omega, "Test Thickness (µm)"),
  get_omega_draws(model_spine_por_consistency_omega, "Spine Biomineral (%)"),
  get_omega_draws(model_spine_dia_consistency_omega, "Spine Thickness (µm)"),
  get_omega_draws(model_spine_len_consistency_omega, "Spine Length (mm)"),
  get_omega_draws(model_jaw_len_consistency_omega, "Jaw Length (mm)")
)

# ---- Plot ---- #
sum_95 <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_Omega_z, .width = 0.95) %>%
  rename(
    median      = b_Omega_z,
    hdi_95_low  = .lower,
    hdi_95_high = .upper
  )

sum_50 <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_Omega_z, .width = 0.50) %>%
  rename(
    hdi_50_low  = .lower,
    hdi_50_high = .upper
  )

effects_sum <- sum_95 %>%
  left_join(sum_50, by = "response")

effects_sum <- effects_sum %>%
  mutate(
    median_flip   = -median,
    hdi_95_low_flip = -hdi_95_high,
    hdi_95_high_flip = -hdi_95_low,
    hdi_50_low_flip  = -hdi_50_high,
    hdi_50_high_flip = -hdi_50_low
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    seg_color = case_when(
      median_flip > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      median_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE            ~ "#ffc857ff"
    ),
    fill_color = case_when(
      hdi_95_low_flip  > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      hdi_95_high_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE                 ~ "#FFFFFF"
    ),
    response = factor(response, levels = c(
      "Jaw Length (mm)",
      "Spine Length (mm)",
      "Spine Thickness (µm)",
      "Spine Biomineral (%)",
      "Test Thickness (µm)",
      "Test Biomineral (%)"
    ))
  )

SiteEffects_Omega <- ggplot(effects_sum, aes(x = median_flip, y = response)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = hdi_95_low_flip, xend = hdi_95_high_flip, yend = response, color = seg_color),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = hdi_50_low_flip, xend = hdi_50_high_flip, yend = response, color = seg_color),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = fill_color),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(
    x = expression("β ("*Omega[Mg-calcite]*")"),
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),

  )

SiteEffects_Omega
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# MG-CALCITE OMEGA MODELS
# EFFECTS REPORTED IN ORIGINAL TRAIT UNITS
# ==================================================

library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)


# ==================================================
# 1. DEFINE MODELS
# ==================================================

models_omega_original <- list(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = model_biom_consistency_omega,
  "Test thickness (µm)" = model_thi_consistency_omega,
  "Jaw length (mm)" = model_jaw_len_consistency_omega,
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = model_spine_por_consistency_omega,
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = model_spine_dia_consistency_omega,
  "Spine length (mm)" = model_spine_len_consistency_omega
)


# ==================================================
# 2. DEFINE ORIGINAL TRAIT VARIABLES
# ==================================================

trait_variables_omega <- c(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = "Biomineral",
  "Test thickness (µm)" = "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw length (mm)" = "Jaw_length",
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine length (mm)" = "Spine_length"
)


# ==================================================
# 3. CALCULATE ORIGINAL TRAIT SDs
# ==================================================

trait_sd_omega <- sapply(
  trait_variables_omega,
  function(trait) {
    sd(dat_all[[trait]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
)

# Convert spine diameter from mm to µm
trait_sd_omega["Spine thickness (µm)"] <-
  trait_sd_omega["Spine thickness (µm)"] * 1000

trait_sd_omega


# ==================================================
# 4. EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS
#    AND BACK-TRANSFORM TO ORIGINAL TRAIT UNITS
# ==================================================

extract_omega_draws_original <- function(
    model,
    response_name
) {

  draws <- as_draws_df(model)

  # SD of original response in reporting units
  response_sd <- trait_sd_omega[[response_name]]

  # Reverse coefficient to represent decreasing Mg-calcite Omega
  effect <- -draws[["b_Omega_z"]]

  # Convert standardised response effect
  # into original trait measurement units
  effect_original <- effect * response_sd

  tibble(
    response = response_name,
    effect = effect_original
  )
}


# ==================================================
# 5. EXTRACT DRAWS FROM ALL SIX MODELS
# ==================================================

draws_omega_original <- bind_rows(

  lapply(
    names(models_omega_original),

    function(response_name) {

      extract_omega_draws_original(
        models_omega_original[[response_name]],
        response_name
      )

    }
  )

)


# ==================================================
# 6. SUMMARISE POSTERIOR
#    MEAN AND 95% CREDIBLE INTERVAL
# ==================================================

effects_table_omega_original <-

  draws_omega_original %>%

  group_by(response) %>%

  summarise(
    Mean = mean(effect),
    `2.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    `97.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==================================================
# 7. CREATE WIDE TABLE
# ==================================================

effects_table_omega_original_wide <-

  effects_table_omega_original %>%

  mutate(
    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = c(
        "Test biomineral (%)",
        "Test thickness (µm)",
        "Jaw length (mm)",
        "Spine biomineral (%)",
        "Spine thickness (µm)",
        "Spine length (mm)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = response,
    values_from = c(Mean, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
    names_glue = "{response}_{.value}"
  ) %>%

  select(
    `Test biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Test thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Jaw length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Spine thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Spine length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine length (mm)_97.5%`
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 3)
    )
  )


# ==================================================
# 8. INSPECT TABLE
# ==================================================

effects_table_omega_original_wide


# ==================================================
# 9. SAVE TABLE
# ==================================================

write.csv(
  effects_table_omega_original_wide,
  "ResultsTables/effects_table_omega_mg_calcite_original_units.csv",
```

```{r}
# Test Biomineral
model_biom_consistency_calcite <- brm(
  Biomineral_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + Omega_calc_z + scale(pH_var) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
)

# Test Thickness
model_thi_consistency_calcite <- brm(
  Thickness_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + Omega_calc_z + scale(pH_var) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),
  data = dat_all,
  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)

# Jaw Length
model_jaw_len_consistency_calcite <- brm(

# Spine Biomineral
model_spine_por_consistency_calcite <- brm(
  SpineBiomineral_z ~ scale(TestDiameter) + Omega_calc_z + scale(pH_var) +
    (1 | Analogue/SitePair) + (1 | Genus),

  iter = 4000, chains = 3, cores = 3, seed = 123,

# Spine Diameter
model_spine_dia_consistency_calcite <- brm(

# =========================================================
# EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS
# =========================================================

get_calcite_draws <- function(model, response_name) {
  as_draws_df(model) %>%
    select(b_Omega_calc_z) %>%
    mutate(response = response_name)
}

draws_all_calcite <- bind_rows(
  get_calcite_draws(model_biom_consistency_calcite, "Test Biomineral (%)"),
  get_calcite_draws(model_thi_consistency_calcite, "Test Thickness (µm)"),
  get_calcite_draws(model_spine_por_consistency_calcite, "Spine Biomineral (%)"),
  get_calcite_draws(model_spine_dia_consistency_calcite, "Spine Thickness (µm)"),
  get_calcite_draws(model_spine_len_consistency_calcite, "Spine Length (mm)"),
  get_calcite_draws(model_jaw_len_consistency_calcite, "Jaw Length (mm)")
)

# =========================================================
# POSTERIOR SUMMARIES
# =========================================================

sum_95_calcite <- draws_all_calcite %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_Omega_calc_z, .width = 0.95) %>%
  rename(
    median       = b_Omega_calc_z,
    hdi_95_low   = .lower,
    hdi_95_high  = .upper
  )

sum_50_calcite <- draws_all_calcite %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  median_hdi(b_Omega_calc_z, .width = 0.50) %>%
  rename(
    hdi_50_low   = .lower,
    hdi_50_high  = .upper
  )

effects_sum_calcite <- sum_95_calcite %>%
  left_join(sum_50_calcite, by = "response")

effects_sum_calcite <- effects_sum_calcite %>%
  mutate(
    median_flip       = -median,
    hdi_95_low_flip   = -hdi_95_high,
    hdi_95_high_flip  = -hdi_95_low,
    hdi_50_low_flip   = -hdi_50_high,
    hdi_50_high_flip  = -hdi_50_low
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    seg_color = case_when(
      median_flip > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      median_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE             ~ "#ffc857ff"
    ),
    fill_color = case_when(
      hdi_95_low_flip  > 0 ~ "#ffc857ff",
      hdi_95_high_flip < 0 ~ "#9c7acfff",
      TRUE                  ~ "#FFFFFF"
    ),
    response = factor(response, levels = c(
      "Jaw Length (mm)",
      "Spine Length (mm)",
      "Spine Thickness (µm)",
      "Spine Biomineral (%)",
      "Test Thickness (µm)",
      "Test Biomineral (%)"
    ))
  )

# =========================================================
# PLOT
# =========================================================

SiteEffects_Calcite <- ggplot(
  effects_sum_calcite,
  aes(x = median_flip, y = response)
) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = hdi_95_low_flip,
      xend = hdi_95_high_flip,
      yend = response,
      color = seg_color
    ),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = hdi_50_low_flip,
      xend = hdi_50_high_flip,
      yend = response,
      color = seg_color
    ),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(fill = fill_color),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +

  labs(
    x = expression("β (" * Omega[calcite] * ")"),
    y = ""
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +

  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

SiteEffects_Calcite
```
