# Extract posterior means
```{r}

# ==================================================
# CALCITE OMEGA MODELS
# EFFECTS REPORTED IN ORIGINAL TRAIT UNITS
# ==================================================

# ==================================================
# 1. DEFINE MODELS
# ==================================================

models_calcite_original <- list(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = model_biom_consistency_calcite,
  "Test thickness (µm)" = model_thi_consistency_calcite,
  "Jaw length (mm)" = model_jaw_len_consistency_calcite,
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = model_spine_por_consistency_calcite,
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = model_spine_dia_consistency_calcite,
  "Spine length (mm)" = model_spine_len_consistency_calcite
)


# ==================================================
# 2. DEFINE ORIGINAL TRAIT VARIABLES
# ==================================================

trait_variables_calcite <- c(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = "Biomineral",
  "Test thickness (µm)" = "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw length (mm)" = "Jaw_length",
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine length (mm)" = "Spine_length"
)


# ==================================================
# 3. CALCULATE ORIGINAL TRAIT SDs
# ==================================================

trait_sd_calcite <- sapply(
  trait_variables_calcite,
  function(trait) {
    sd(dat_all[[trait]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
)

# Convert spine diameter SD from mm to µm
trait_sd_calcite["Spine thickness (µm)"] <-
  trait_sd_calcite["Spine thickness (µm)"] * 1000

trait_sd_calcite


# ==================================================
# 4. EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS
#    AND BACK-TRANSFORM TO ORIGINAL TRAIT UNITS
# ==================================================

extract_calcite_draws_original <- function(
    model,
    response_name
) {

  draws <- as_draws_df(model)

  # SD of original response in reporting units
  response_sd <- trait_sd_calcite[[response_name]]

  # Reverse coefficient to represent decreasing calcite Omega
  effect <- -draws[["b_Omega_calc_z"]]

  # Convert standardised response effect
  # into original trait measurement units
  effect_original <- effect * response_sd

  tibble(
    response = response_name,
    effect = effect_original
  )
}


# ==================================================
# 5. EXTRACT DRAWS FROM ALL SIX MODELS
# ==================================================

draws_calcite_original <- bind_rows(

  lapply(
    names(models_calcite_original),

    function(response_name) {

      extract_calcite_draws_original(
        models_calcite_original[[response_name]],
        response_name
      )

    }
  )

)


# ==================================================
# 6. SUMMARISE POSTERIOR
#    MEAN AND 95% CREDIBLE INTERVAL
# ==================================================

effects_table_calcite_original <-

  draws_calcite_original %>%

  group_by(response) %>%

  summarise(
    Mean = mean(effect),
    `2.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    `97.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==================================================
# 7. CREATE WIDE TABLE
# ==================================================

effects_table_calcite_original_wide <-

  effects_table_calcite_original %>%

  mutate(
    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = c(
        "Test biomineral (%)",
        "Test thickness (µm)",
        "Jaw length (mm)",
        "Spine biomineral (%)",
        "Spine thickness (µm)",
        "Spine length (mm)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = response,
    values_from = c(Mean, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
    names_glue = "{response}_{.value}"
  ) %>%

  select(
    `Test biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Test thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Jaw length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Spine thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Spine length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine length (mm)_97.5%`
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 3)
    )
  )


# ==================================================
# 8. INSPECT TABLE
# ==================================================

effects_table_calcite_original_wide


# ==================================================
# 9. SAVE TABLE
# ==================================================

write.csv(
  effects_table_calcite_original_wide,
  "ResultsTables/effects_table_omega_calcite_original_units.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```



# pH x Absolute Latitude interaction models
```{r}
traits <- c(
  "Biomineral",
  "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw_length",
  "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine_length"
)

dat_all$Abs_lat_z <- as.numeric(scale(dat_all$Abs_lat))

lat_mean <- mean(dat_all$Abs_lat)
lat_sd   <- sd(dat_all$Abs_lat)

pH_mean  <- mean(dat_all$median_pH)
pH_sd    <- sd(dat_all$median_pH)

lat_vals <- c(10, 25, 40)
lat_vals_z <- (lat_vals - lat_mean) / lat_sd

pH_lat_models <- list()

for(trait in traits){

  formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(trait, " ~ 1 +
           pH_z * Abs_lat_z +
           TestDiameter_z +
           (1 + pH_z || Genus) +
           (1 | Analogue/SitePair)")
  )

  pH_lat_models[[trait]] <- brm(
    formula = formula,
    data = dat_all,
    iter = 4000,
    chains = 3,
    cores = 3,
    seed = 1999,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
  )
}

size_corrected_data <- list()

for(trait in traits){

  mod <- pH_lat_models[[trait]]
  beta_size <- fixef(mod)["TestDiameter_z","Estimate"]

  tmp <- dat_all %>%
    mutate(
      trait_value = .data[[trait]],
      trait_corr  = trait_value - beta_size * TestDiameter_z
    )

  size_corrected_data[[trait]] <- tmp
}

trait_to_label <- c(
  Biomineral = "Predicted Test Biomineral (%)",
  ThicknessCT.um. = "Predicted Test Thickness (µm)",
  SpineBiomineral = "Predicted Spine Biomineral (%)",
  Spine_diameter = "Predicted Spine Thickness (µm)",
  Spine_length = "Predicted Spine Length (mm)",
  Jaw_length = "Predicted Jaw Length (mm)"
)

fitted_plots <- list()

for(trait in traits){

  mod <- pH_lat_models[[trait]]

  newdata <- expand.grid(
    pH_z = seq(min(dat_all$pH_z),
               max(dat_all$pH_z),
               length.out = 100),
    Abs_lat_z = lat_vals_z,
    TestDiameter_z = 0
  )

  fitted <- add_epred_draws(mod,
                            newdata = newdata,
                            re_formula = NA)

  fitted <- fitted %>%
    mutate(
      median_pH = pH_z * pH_sd + pH_mean,
      Abs_lat   = Abs_lat_z * lat_sd + lat_mean,
      lat_zone = case_when(
        Abs_lat < 23.5 ~ 10,
        Abs_lat <= 35  ~ 25,
        Abs_lat > 35   ~ 40
      ),
      lat_label = factor(
        lat_zone,
        levels = c(40,25,10),
        labels = c("40°","25°","10°")
      )
    )

  fitted_summary <- fitted %>%
    group_by(median_pH, lat_label) %>%
    median_hdci(.epred, .width = c(0.95, 0.5)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(lat_label, median_pH)

  hd95 <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>% 
    select(median_pH, lat_label,
           hdi_95_low = .lower,
           hdi_95_high = .upper)

  hd50 <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.5) %>% 
    select(median_pH, lat_label,
           hdi_50_low = .lower,
           hdi_50_high = .upper)

  median_vals <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>% 
    select(median_pH, lat_label,
           median = .epred)

  plot_data <- median_vals %>%
    left_join(hd95, by = c("median_pH","lat_label")) %>%
    left_join(hd50, by = c("median_pH","lat_label"))

  overlay_data <- size_corrected_data[[trait]] %>%
    mutate(
      lat_zone = case_when(
        Abs_lat < 23.5 ~ 10,
        Abs_lat <= 35  ~ 25,
        Abs_lat > 35   ~ 40
      ),
      lat_label = factor(
        lat_zone,
        levels = c(40,25,10),
        labels = c("40°","25°","10°")
      )
    )

  y_label <- trait_to_label[[trait]]

  p <- ggplot(plot_data,
              aes(x = median_pH, y = median)) +

    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hdi_95_low,
                    ymax = hdi_95_high,
                    fill = lat_label,
                    group = lat_label),
                alpha = 0.2) +

    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hdi_50_low,
                    ymax = hdi_50_high,
                    fill = lat_label,
                    group = lat_label),
                alpha = 0.4) +

   geom_line(aes(group = lat_label),
          color = "black",
          size = 1) +

    geom_point(data = overlay_data,
               aes(x = median_pH,
                   y = trait_corr,
                   color = lat_label),
               alpha = 0.6,
               size = 2,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +

    facet_wrap(~ lat_label) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "40°" = "lightblue",
      "25°" = "orange",
      "10°" = "red"
    )) +

    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "40°" = "lightblue",
      "25°" = "orange",
      "10°" = "red"
    )) +

    scale_x_reverse(
      limits = c(8.13, 7.53),
      breaks = seq(7.6, 8.0, by = 0.2),
      expand = c(0.02,0.02)
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                  fill = NA,
                                  size = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(x = expression("pH"[T]), y = y_label)

  fitted_plots[[trait]] <- p
  print(p)
}

combined_pH_lat_line_plot <- wrap_plots(fitted_plots, ncol = 3)
combined_pH_lat_line_plot

ggsave(
  "Figures/MainText/Combined_pH_lat_lineplots.svg",
  combined_pH_lat_line_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 8
)
```

# pH x Abs. Lat + pH var
```{r}

# ============================================================
# MEDIAN pHT × LATITUDE MODELS, INCLUDING pHT VARIABILITY
# ============================================================

library(brms)
library(dplyr)
library(tidybayes)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define traits
# ------------------------------------------------------------

traits <- c(
  "Biomineral",
  "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw_length",
  "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine_length"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Standardise environmental predictors at the site level
# ------------------------------------------------------------
exposure_units <- dat_all %>%
  group_by(Analogue, SitePair) %>%
  summarise(
    median_pH = first(median_pH[!is.na(median_pH)]),
    Abs_lat   = first(Abs_lat[!is.na(Abs_lat)]),
    pH_var    = first(pH_var[!is.na(pH_var)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate means and SDs from independent exposure units

pH_mean <- mean(exposure_units$median_pH, na.rm = TRUE)
pH_sd   <- sd(exposure_units$median_pH, na.rm = TRUE)

lat_mean <- mean(exposure_units$Abs_lat, na.rm = TRUE)
lat_sd   <- sd(exposure_units$Abs_lat, na.rm = TRUE)

pH_var_mean <- mean(exposure_units$pH_var, na.rm = TRUE)
pH_var_sd   <- sd(exposure_units$pH_var, na.rm = TRUE)

# Apply the same transformations to the individual-level dataset

dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    median_pH_z = (median_pH - pH_mean) / pH_sd,
    Abs_lat_z   = (Abs_lat - lat_mean) / lat_sd,
    pH_var_z    = (pH_var - pH_var_mean) / pH_var_sd
  )

# Latitude values for predictions

lat_vals <- c(10, 25, 40)

lat_vals_z <- (lat_vals - lat_mean) / lat_sd


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Fit Bayesian mixed-effects models for all traits
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Model:
#
# Trait ~ median pHT × absolute latitude
#       + pHT variability
#       + test diameter
#       + random intercept and median pHT slope for Genus
#       + random intercept for SitePair nested within Analogue
#
# pH variability is held constant in the predictions below,
# but included as an additive predictor in the model.

med_var_pH_lat_models <- list()

for (trait in traits) {

  message("Fitting model for: ", trait)

  formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      trait,
      " ~ 1 +
       median_pH_z * Abs_lat_z +
       pH_var_z +
       TestDiameter_z +
       (1 + median_pH_z || Genus) +
       (1 | Analogue/SitePair)"
    )
  )

  med_var_pH_lat_models[[trait]] <- brm(
    formula = formula,
    data = dat_all,
    iter = 4000,
    chains = 3,
    cores = 3,
    seed = 1999,
    control = list(
      adapt_delta = 0.99,
      max_treedepth = 15
    )
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Inspect model summaries
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for (trait in traits) {

  cat("\n\n========================================\n")
  cat("TRAIT:", trait, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")

  print(summary(med_var_pH_lat_models[[trait]]))
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Size-correct observed trait values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Correct observed trait values to the expected value at mean
# test diameter (TestDiameter_z = 0), using the posterior mean
# estimate of the test diameter coefficient.

size_corrected_data <- list()

for (trait in traits) {

  mod <- med_var_pH_lat_models[[trait]]

  beta_size <- fixef(mod)["TestDiameter_z", "Estimate"]

  tmp <- dat_all %>%
    mutate(
      trait_value = .data[[trait]],
      trait_corr  = trait_value - beta_size * TestDiameter_z
    )

  size_corrected_data[[trait]] <- tmp
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Define trait labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

trait_to_label <- c(
  Biomineral = "Predicted Test Biomineral (%)",
  ThicknessCT.um. = "Predicted Test Thickness (µm)",
  SpineBiomineral = "Predicted Spine Biomineral (%)",
  Spine_diameter = "Predicted Spine Thickness (µm)",
  Spine_length = "Predicted Spine Length (mm)",
  Jaw_length = "Predicted Jaw Length (mm)"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Generate predictions and plots for each trait
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fitted_plots <- list()

for (trait in traits) {

  message("Generating plot for: ", trait)

  mod <- med_var_pH_lat_models[[trait]]

  # Prediction grid:
  # - median pHT varies across the observed range
  # - latitude is fixed at 10°, 25° and 40°
  # - test diameter is held at its mean
  # - pHT variability is held at its mean

  newdata <- expand.grid(
    median_pH_z = seq(
      min(dat_all$median_pH_z, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(dat_all$median_pH_z, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 100
    ),
    Abs_lat_z = lat_vals_z,
    TestDiameter_z = 0,
    pH_var_z = 0
  )

  # Population-level predictions (excluding random effects)

  fitted <- add_epred_draws(
    mod,
    newdata = newdata,
    re_formula = NA
  )

  # Convert standardised predictors back to their original scales

  fitted <- fitted %>%
    mutate(
      median_pH = median_pH_z * pH_sd + pH_mean,
      Abs_lat   = Abs_lat_z * lat_sd + lat_mean,

      lat_label = factor(
        round(Abs_lat),
        levels = c(40, 25, 10),
        labels = c("40°", "25°", "10°")
      )
    )

  # Summarise posterior predictions

  fitted_summary <- fitted %>%
    group_by(median_pH, lat_label) %>%
    median_hdci(
      .epred,
      .width = c(0.95, 0.5)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(lat_label, median_pH)

  # 95% HDI

  hd95 <- fitted_summary %>%
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>%
    select(
      median_pH,
      lat_label,
      hdi_95_low = .lower,
      hdi_95_high = .upper
    )

  # 50% HDI

  hd50 <- fitted_summary %>%
    filter(.width == 0.5) %>%
    select(
      median_pH,
      lat_label,
      hdi_50_low = .lower,
      hdi_50_high = .upper
    )

  # Posterior median

  median_vals <- fitted_summary %>%
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>%
    select(
      median_pH,
      lat_label,
      median = .epred
    )

  # Combine posterior medians and HDIs

  plot_data <- median_vals %>%
    left_join(
      hd95,
      by = c("median_pH", "lat_label")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      hd50,
      by = c("median_pH", "lat_label")
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Observed data overlay
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  overlay_data <- size_corrected_data[[trait]] %>%
    mutate(
      lat_zone = case_when(
        Abs_lat < 23.5 ~ 10,
        Abs_lat <= 35  ~ 25,
        Abs_lat > 35   ~ 40
      ),

      lat_label = factor(
        lat_zone,
        levels = c(40, 25, 10),
        labels = c("40°", "25°", "10°")
      )
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  y_label <- trait_to_label[[trait]]

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = median_pH, y = median)
  ) +

    # 95% HDI

    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = hdi_95_low,
        ymax = hdi_95_high,
        fill = lat_label,
        group = lat_label
      ),
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +

    # 50% HDI

    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = hdi_50_low,
        ymax = hdi_50_high,
        fill = lat_label,
        group = lat_label
      ),
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +

    # Posterior median prediction

    geom_line(
      aes(group = lat_label),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    # Size-corrected observed values

    geom_point(
      data = overlay_data,
      aes(
        x = median_pH,
        y = trait_corr,
        color = lat_label
      ),
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 2,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    facet_wrap(~ lat_label) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "40°" = "lightblue",
        "25°" = "orange",
        "10°" = "red"
      )
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "40°" = "lightblue",
        "25°" = "orange",
        "10°" = "red"
      )
    ) +

    scale_x_reverse(
      limits = c(8.13, 7.53),
      breaks = seq(7.6, 8.0, by = 0.2),
      expand = c(0.02, 0.02)
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 1
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +

    labs(
      x = expression("pH"[T]),
      y = y_label
    )

  fitted_plots[[trait]] <- p

  print(p)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Combine all six plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined_med_var_pH_lat_line_plot <- wrap_plots(
  fitted_plots,
  ncol = 3
)

combined_med_var_pH_lat_line_plot


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save figure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  "Figures/MainText/Combined_med_var_pH_lat_lineplots.svg",
  combined_med_var_pH_lat_line_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 8
)
```

# Extract posterior means and HDIs
```{r}
# ============================================================
# EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS FOR ALL FIVE PREDICTORS
# MEDIAN pHT × LATITUDE MODELS, INCLUDING pHT VARIABILITY
# ============================================================

library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

models_med_var_pH_lat <- list(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = med_var_pH_lat_models[["Biomineral"]],
  "Test thickness (µm)" = med_var_pH_lat_models[["ThicknessCT.um."]],
  "Jaw length (mm)" = med_var_pH_lat_models[["Jaw_length"]],
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = med_var_pH_lat_models[["SpineBiomineral"]],
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = med_var_pH_lat_models[["Spine_diameter"]],
  "Spine length (mm)" = med_var_pH_lat_models[["Spine_length"]]
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define model parameters and labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parameters <- tibble(
  parameter = c(
    "b_TestDiameter_z",
    "b_median_pH_z",
    "b_Abs_lat_z",
    "b_median_pH_z:Abs_lat_z",
    "b_pH_var_z"
  ),

  predictor = c(
    "Test diameter",
    "Decreasing median pHT",
    "Absolute latitude",
    "Decreasing median pHT × absolute latitude",
    "pHT variability"
  ),

  reverse = c(
    FALSE,
    TRUE,
    FALSE,
    TRUE,
    FALSE
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Extract posterior draws
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_all_draws <- function(model, response_name) {

  draws <- as_draws_df(model)

  bind_rows(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(parameters)), function(i) {

      param <- parameters$parameter[i]

      effect <- draws[[param]]

      # Reverse median pHT and its interaction with latitude
      # to represent decreasing median pHT
      if (parameters$reverse[i]) {
        effect <- -effect
      }

      # Convert spine thickness from mm to µm
      if (response_name == "Spine thickness (µm)") {
        effect <- effect * 1000
      }

      tibble(
        response = response_name,
        predictor = parameters$predictor[i],
        effect = effect
      )

    })
  )
}


draws_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(models_med_var_pH_lat), function(response_name) {

    extract_all_draws(
      models_med_var_pH_lat[[response_name]],
      response_name
    )

  })
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Summarise posterior estimates
# Mean and 95% credible interval
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_table_med_var_pH_lat <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(predictor, response) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(effect),
    `2.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    `97.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create wide table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_table_med_var_pH_lat_wide <- effects_table_med_var_pH_lat %>%

  mutate(
    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = c(
        "Test diameter",
        "Decreasing median pHT",
        "Absolute latitude",
        "Decreasing median pHT × absolute latitude",
        "pHT variability"
      )
    ),

    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = c(
        "Test biomineral (%)",
        "Test thickness (µm)",
        "Jaw length (mm)",
        "Spine biomineral (%)",
        "Spine thickness (µm)",
        "Spine length (mm)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = response,
    values_from = c(Mean, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
    names_glue = "{response}_{.value}"
  ) %>%

  arrange(predictor) %>%

  # Reorder columns by trait, with Mean, 2.5%, 97.5%
  select(
    predictor,

    `Test biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Test thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Jaw length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Spine thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Spine length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine length (mm)_97.5%`
  ) %>%

  # Round all estimates to 3 significant figures
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 3)
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Inspect table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_table_med_var_pH_lat_wide


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save table
# ------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(
  effects_table_med_var_pH_lat_wide,
  "ResultsTables/effects_table_med_var_pH_lat_models.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


# pH regime x Latitude models (no Whakaari / White Island)
```{r}
# ============================================================
# pH x ABSOLUTE LATITUDE INTERACTION MODELS
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS EXCLUDING WHITE ISLAND / WHAKAARI
#
# Responses:
#   Original, unstandardised trait measurements
#
# Predictors:
#   Standardised median pHT
#   Standardised absolute latitude
#   Standardised test diameter
#   pHT variability (standardised within the model)
#
# Random effects:
#   (1 + pH_z || Genus) + (1 | Analogue/SitePair)
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Six Bayesian interaction models
#   2. Six fitted latitude-interaction plots
#   3. Combined six-panel figure
#   4. Bayesian R2 table
#   5. Model diagnostic plots
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# dat_no_whakaari already excludes White Island / Whakaari.
#
# median_pH_z is the standardised median pHT variable
# calculated for the reduced dataset.

dat_no_whakaari <- dat_no_whakaari %>%
  mutate(
    Abs_lat_z = as.numeric(scale(Abs_lat)),
    pH_z = median_pH_z
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate reduced-dataset predictor means and SDs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lat_mean_no_whakaari <- mean(
  dat_no_whakaari$Abs_lat,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

lat_sd_no_whakaari <- sd(
  dat_no_whakaari$Abs_lat,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pH_mean_no_whakaari <- mean(
  dat_no_whakaari$median_pH,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pH_sd_no_whakaari <- sd(
  dat_no_whakaari$median_pH,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define latitude prediction values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lat_vals <- c(10, 25, 40)

lat_vals_z_no_whakaari <- (
  lat_vals - lat_mean_no_whakaari
) / lat_sd_no_whakaari


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define original response variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

traits_raw <- c(
  "Biomineral",
  "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw_length",
  "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine_length"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Define response labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

trait_to_label_original <- c(
  Biomineral = "Predicted Test Biomineral (%)",
  ThicknessCT.um. = "Predicted Test Thickness (µm)",
  Jaw_length = "Predicted Jaw Length (mm)",
  SpineBiomineral = "Predicted Spine Biomineral (%)",
  Spine_diameter = "Predicted Spine Thickness (µm)",
  Spine_length = "Predicted Spine Length (mm)"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Fit six Bayesian pH x latitude interaction models
#
# Responses are in original measurement units.
# Predictors are standardised.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pH_lat_models_no_whakaari <- list()

for (trait in traits_raw) {

  formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "`", trait, "` ~ 1 +
        pH_z * Abs_lat_z +
        scale(pH_var) +
        TestDiameter_z +
        (1 + pH_z || Genus) +
        (1 | Analogue/SitePair)"
    )
  )

  cat("\nFitting model:", trait, "\n")

  pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[[trait]] <- brm(
    formula = formula,
    data = dat_no_whakaari,
    iter = 4000,
    chains = 3,
    cores = 3,
    seed = 1999,
    control = list(
      adapt_delta = 0.99,
      max_treedepth = 15
    )
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Size-correct observed data
#
# Original measurement units.
#
# Correct observations for test diameter using the
# posterior mean fixed-effect coefficient.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

size_corrected_data_no_whakaari <- list()

for (trait in traits_raw) {

  mod <- pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[[trait]]

  # Extract test diameter coefficient
  # Already expressed in original response units
  beta_size_original <- fixef(mod)[
    "TestDiameter_z",
    "Estimate"
  ]

  # Original response variable
  tmp <- dat_no_whakaari %>%
    mutate(
      trait_value = .data[[trait]],

      trait_corr = trait_value -
        beta_size_original * TestDiameter_z
    )

  size_corrected_data_no_whakaari[[trait]] <- tmp
}


# ============================================================
# 8. Generate fitted latitude-interaction plots
# ============================================================

fitted_plots_no_whakaari <- list()

for (trait in traits_raw) {

  cat("\nGenerating plot:", trait, "\n")

  mod <- pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[[trait]]


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.1 Prediction grid
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  newdata <- expand.grid(
    pH_z = seq(
      min(dat_no_whakaari$pH_z, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(dat_no_whakaari$pH_z, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 100
    ),

    Abs_lat_z = lat_vals_z_no_whakaari,

    TestDiameter_z = 0,

    pH_var = mean(
      dat_no_whakaari$pH_var,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.2 Posterior predictions
  #
  # Population-level predictions:
  # random effects excluded.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fitted <- add_epred_draws(
    mod,
    newdata = newdata,
    re_formula = NA
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.3 Convert predictors back to original scales
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fitted <- fitted %>%
    mutate(
      median_pH =
        pH_z * pH_sd_no_whakaari +
        pH_mean_no_whakaari,

      Abs_lat =
        Abs_lat_z * lat_sd_no_whakaari +
        lat_mean_no_whakaari,

      lat_zone = case_when(
        Abs_lat < 23.5 ~ 10,
        Abs_lat <= 35 ~ 25,
        Abs_lat > 35 ~ 40
      ),

      lat_label = factor(
        lat_zone,
        levels = c(40, 25, 10),
        labels = c("40°", "25°", "10°")
      )
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.4 Summarise posterior predictions
  #
  # Predictions are already in original measurement units.
  # No response back-transformation is required.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fitted_summary <- fitted %>%
    group_by(median_pH, lat_label) %>%
    median_hdci(
      .epred,
      .width = c(0.95, 0.5)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(lat_label, median_pH)


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.5 Extract 95% HDI
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  hd95 <- fitted_summary %>%
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>%
    select(
      median_pH,
      lat_label,
      hdi_95_low = .lower,
      hdi_95_high = .upper
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.6 Extract 50% HDI
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  hd50 <- fitted_summary %>%
    filter(.width == 0.5) %>%
    select(
      median_pH,
      lat_label,
      hdi_50_low = .lower,
      hdi_50_high = .upper
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.7 Extract posterior median predictions
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  median_vals <- fitted_summary %>%
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>%
    select(
      median_pH,
      lat_label,
      median = .epred
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.8 Combine prediction summaries
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  plot_data <- median_vals %>%
    left_join(
      hd95,
      by = c("median_pH", "lat_label")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      hd50,
      by = c("median_pH", "lat_label")
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.9 Prepare size-corrected observed data
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  overlay_data <- size_corrected_data_no_whakaari[[trait]] %>%
    mutate(
      lat_zone = case_when(
        Abs_lat < 23.5 ~ 10,
        Abs_lat <= 35 ~ 25,
        Abs_lat > 35 ~ 40
      ),

      lat_label = factor(
        lat_zone,
        levels = c(40, 25, 10),
        labels = c("40°", "25°", "10°")
      )
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.10 Plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  y_label <- trait_to_label_original[[trait]]

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = median_pH,
      y = median
    )
  ) +

    # 95% HDI
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = hdi_95_low,
        ymax = hdi_95_high,
        fill = lat_label,
        group = lat_label
      ),
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +

    # 50% HDI
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = hdi_50_low,
        ymax = hdi_50_high,
        fill = lat_label,
        group = lat_label
      ),
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +

    # Posterior median
    geom_line(
      aes(group = lat_label),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    # Size-corrected observed values
    geom_point(
      data = overlay_data,
      aes(
        x = median_pH,
        y = trait_corr,
        color = lat_label
      ),
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 2,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    # Separate latitude panels
    facet_wrap(~ lat_label) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "40°" = "lightblue",
        "25°" = "orange",
        "10°" = "red"
      )
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "40°" = "lightblue",
        "25°" = "orange",
        "10°" = "red"
      )
    ) +

    # Lower pHT to the right
    scale_x_reverse(
      limits = c(8.13, 7.53),
      breaks = seq(7.6, 8.0, by = 0.2),
      expand = c(0.02, 0.02)
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 1
      ),

      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      x = expression("pH"[T]),
      y = y_label
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8.11 Store and display plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fitted_plots_no_whakaari[[trait]] <- p

  print(p)

}


# ============================================================
# 9. Combine six plots
# ============================================================

combined_pH_lat_line_plot_no_whakaari <-
  wrap_plots(
    fitted_plots_no_whakaari,
    ncol = 3
  )

combined_pH_lat_line_plot_no_whakaari


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Save combined figure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(
  "Figures/Supplementary",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  "Figures/Supplementary/Combined_pH_lat_lineplots_excluding_WhiteIsland_original_units.svg",
  combined_pH_lat_line_plot_no_whakaari,
  width = 16,

)


# ============================================================
# 11. Bayesian R2 statistics
# ============================================================

r2_results_no_whakaari <- list()

for (trait in traits_raw) {

  mod <- pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[[trait]]

  r2 <- bayes_R2(mod)

  r2_results_no_whakaari[[trait]] <- data.frame(
    Trait = trait_to_label_original[[trait]],

  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Combine R2 results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

  bind_rows(r2_results_no_whakaari)

r2_results_pH_lat_interaction_no_whakaari

# ============================================================
# 14. Model diagnostic plots
# ============================================================

save_model_diagnostics <- function(
  model,
  model_name,
  folder
) {

  dir.create(
    folder,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  # brms posterior parameter plots
  brms_plots <- plot(model)

  posterior_hist <- brms_plots[[1]]

  posterior_trace <- brms_plots[[2]]


  # Posterior predictive check
  pp <- pp_check(model) +
    ggtitle("Posterior predictive check")


  # Combine diagnostics
  combined <- arrangeGrob(
    posterior_hist,
    posterior_trace,
    pp,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(1, 1, 1.1)
  )


  # Save diagnostic figure
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      folder,
      "/",
      model_name,
      "_ALL_diagnostics.png"
    ),

    plot = combined,

    width = 10,
    height = 16,
    dpi = 300
  )

}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Run diagnostics for all six models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

models_no_whakaari <- pH_lat_models_no_whakaari

invisible(
```

# Extract posterior means
```{r}

# ============================================================
# EXTRACT POSTERIOR EFFECTS
# pH × ABSOLUTE LATITUDE MODELS
# EXCLUDING WHITE ISLAND / WHAKAARI
#
# Responses: Original measurement units
# Effects: Posterior means and 95% credible intervals
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

models_no_whakaari <- list(
  "Test biomineral (%)" =
    pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[["Biomineral"]],

  "Test thickness (µm)" =
    pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[["ThicknessCT.um."]],

  "Jaw length (mm)" =
    pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[["Jaw_length"]],

  "Spine biomineral (%)" =
    pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[["SpineBiomineral"]],

  "Spine thickness (µm)" =
    pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[["Spine_diameter"]],

  "Spine length (mm)" =
    pH_lat_models_no_whakaari[["Spine_length"]]
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define parameters and predictor labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parameters <- c(
  "b_TestDiameter_z" = "Test diameter",
  "b_pH_z" = "Decreasing median pHT",
  "b_Abs_lat_z" = "Absolute latitude",
  "b_pH_z:Abs_lat_z" = "Decreasing median pHT × absolute latitude",
  "b_scalepH_var" = "pHT variability"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Extract posterior draws
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_effects <- function(model, response_name) {

  draws <- as_draws_df(model)

  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(parameters), function(param) {

      # Handle either possible interaction parameter ordering

      actual_param <- param

      if (
        param == "b_pH_z:Abs_lat_z" &&
        !actual_param %in% names(draws)
      ) {
        actual_param <- "b_Abs_lat_z:pH_z"
      }

      if (!actual_param %in% names(draws)) {
        stop(
          paste(
            "Parameter not found:",
            param,
            "in model:",
            response_name,
            "\nAvailable parameters:",
            paste(names(draws), collapse = ", ")
          )
        )
      }

      effect <- draws[[actual_param]]

      # Reverse signs to express effects of decreasing pHT

      if (param %in% c("b_pH_z", "b_pH_z:Abs_lat_z")) {
        effect <- -effect
      }

      # Convert spine thickness from mm to µm only

      if (response_name == "Spine thickness (µm)") {
        effect <- effect * 1000
      }

      tibble(
        response = response_name,
        predictor = parameters[[param]],
        effect = effect
      )

    })
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract effects from all six models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

posterior_effects_no_whakaari <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(models_no_whakaari), function(response_name) {

    extract_effects(
      models_no_whakaari[[response_name]],
      response_name
    )

  })
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Calculate posterior means and 95% credible intervals
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_summary_no_whakaari <- posterior_effects_no_whakaari %>%

  group_by(predictor, response) %>%

  summarise(
    Mean = mean(effect),
    `2.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    `97.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Set predictor and response order
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_summary_no_whakaari <- effects_summary_no_whakaari %>%

  mutate(
    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = c(
        "Test diameter",
        "Decreasing median pHT",
        "Absolute latitude",
        "Decreasing median pHT × absolute latitude",
        "pHT variability"
      )
    ),

    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = c(
        "Test biomineral (%)",
        "Test thickness (µm)",
        "Jaw length (mm)",
        "Spine biomineral (%)",
        "Spine thickness (µm)",
        "Spine length (mm)"
      )
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Convert to wide table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_table_no_whakaari <- effects_summary_no_whakaari %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = response,
    values_from = c(Mean, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
    names_glue = "{response}_{.value}"
  ) %>%

  arrange(predictor) %>%

  select(
    predictor,

    `Test biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Test thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Jaw length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Spine thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Spine length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine length (mm)_97.5%`
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 3)
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Display table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_table_no_whakaari


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(
  "ResultsTables",
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  effects_table_no_whakaari,
  "ResultsTables/effects_table_pH_lat_models_excluding_WhiteIsland_original_units.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Extract posterior means 
```{r}

# ============================================================
# EXTRACT GENUS-SPECIFIC POSTERIOR pHT EFFECTS
#
# Genus-specific slopes at mean absolute latitude
# Direction: decreasing median pHT
# Responses: original measurement units
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define traits and labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

traits <- c(
  "Biomineral",
  "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw_length",
  "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine_length"
)

trait_labels <- c(
  Biomineral = "Test biomineral (%)",
  ThicknessCT.um. = "Test thickness (µm)",
  Jaw_length = "Jaw length (mm)",
  SpineBiomineral = "Spine biomineral (%)",
  Spine_diameter = "Spine thickness (µm)",
  Spine_length = "Spine length (mm)"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define genus order
# ------------------------------------------------------------

genus_order <- c(
  "Arbacia",
  "Paracentrotus",
  "Echinometra",
  "Diadema",
  "Evechinus"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Extract genus-specific posterior slopes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_genus_slopes <- function(model, trait, genus_order) {

  # Extract complete genus-specific posterior coefficients
  genus_coefficients <- coef(
    model,
    summary = FALSE
  )$Genus

  # Check coefficient names
  coefficient_names <- dimnames(genus_coefficients)[[3]]

  if (!"median_pH_z" %in% coefficient_names) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "median_pH_z coefficient not found for",
        trait,
        "\nAvailable coefficients:",
        paste(coefficient_names, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  # Check genus names
  available_genera <- dimnames(genus_coefficients)[[2]]

  bind_rows(
    lapply(genus_order, function(genus) {

      if (!genus %in% available_genera) {
        stop(
          paste(
            "Genus not found in model:",
            genus,
            "for trait:",
            trait,
            "\nAvailable genera:",
            paste(available_genera, collapse = ", ")
          )
        )
      }

      # Extract complete genus-specific median pHT slope
      slope_draws <- genus_coefficients[
        ,
        genus,
        "median_pH_z"
      ]

      # Reverse sign to express effect of decreasing pHT
      slope_draws <- -as.numeric(slope_draws)

      # Convert spine thickness from mm to µm
      if (trait == "Spine_diameter") {
        slope_draws <- slope_draws * 1000
      }

      tibble(
        Genus = genus,
        Trait = trait,
        effect = slope_draws
      )

    })
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract posterior draws from all six models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

genus_pH_draws <- bind_rows(
  lapply(traits, function(trait) {

    extract_genus_slopes(
      model = med_var_pH_lat_models[[trait]],
      trait = trait,
      genus_order = genus_order
    )

  })
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Calculate posterior means and 95% credible intervals
# ------------------------------------------------------------

genus_pH_summary <- genus_pH_draws %>%
  group_by(Genus, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(effect),
    Lower = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    Upper = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Convert to wide table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

genus_pH_table <- genus_pH_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = factor(
      Genus,
      levels = genus_order
    ),

    Trait_label = factor(
      trait_labels[Trait],
      levels = unname(trait_labels[traits])
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Genus,
    names_from = Trait_label,
    values_from = c(Mean, Lower, Upper),
    names_glue = "{Trait_label}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Genus) %>%
  select(
    Genus,

    `Test biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_Lower`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_Upper`,

    `Test thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_Lower`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_Upper`,

    `Jaw length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_Lower`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_Upper`,

    `Spine biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_Lower`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_Upper`,

    `Spine thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_Lower`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_Upper`,

    `Spine length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Spine length (mm)_Lower`,
    `Spine length (mm)_Upper`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 3)
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Rename interval columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

names(genus_pH_table) <- gsub(
  "_Lower$",
  "_2.5%",
  names(genus_pH_table)
)

names(genus_pH_table) <- gsub(
  "_Upper$",
  "_97.5%",
  names(genus_pH_table)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Display table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

genus_pH_table


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Check table dimensions and missing values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nTable dimensions:\n")
print(dim(genus_pH_table))

cat("\nMissing values per column:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(genus_pH_table)))

cat("\nGenus rows:\n")
print(genus_pH_table$Genus)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Save results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  genus_pH_table,
  "ResultsTables/Genus_specific_pH_effects.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Genus-specific deviations from global pH slope
```{r}

# ============================================================
# GENUS-SPECIFIC pHT SLOPES AT MEAN LATITUDE
# ============================================================
traits <- c(
  "Biomineral",
  "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw_length",
  "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine_length"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract posterior slopes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

slope_draws_all <- map_dfr(traits, function(trait) {

  mod <- med_var_pH_lat_models[[trait]]

  # Fixed-effect posterior draws
  fix_draws <- fixef(mod, summary = FALSE)

  # Genus-level random-effect posterior draws
  ran_draws <- ranef(mod, summary = FALSE)$Genus

  genera <- dimnames(ran_draws)[[2]]

  # Population-level pHT slope at mean latitude
  global_slope <- fix_draws[, "median_pH_z"]

  map_dfr(genera, function(genus) {

    # Genus-specific random slope deviation
    genus_deviation <- ran_draws[
      , genus, "median_pH_z"
    ]

    # Genus-specific pHT slope
    genus_slope <- global_slope + genus_deviation

    # Difference from population-level slope
    difference <- genus_slope - global_slope

    tibble(
      Trait = trait,
      Genus = genus,
      Global_slope = global_slope,
      Genus_slope = genus_slope,
      Difference = difference
    )
  })
})

# ============================================================
# 2. SUMMARISE POSTERIOR DISTRIBUTIONS
# ============================================================

genus_slope_summary <- slope_draws_all %>%
  group_by(Trait, Genus) %>%
  summarise(

    # Population-level pHT slope
    Global_slope = median(Global_slope),

    # Genus-specific pHT slope
    Genus_slope = median(Genus_slope),
    Genus_slope_lower = quantile(Genus_slope, 0.025),
    Genus_slope_upper = quantile(Genus_slope, 0.975),

    # Difference: genus slope - global slope
    Slope_difference = median(Difference),
    Difference_lower = quantile(Difference, 0.025),
    Difference_upper = quantile(Difference, 0.975),

    # Probability of a more positive pHT slope
    # (stronger decline under reduced pHT)
    Probability_stronger_decline = mean(Difference > 0),

    # Probability of a more negative pHT slope
    Probability_more_negative_slope = mean(Difference < 0),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Trait, Genus)

# ============================================================
# 3. CLEAN TABLE FOR DISPLAY / EXPORT
# ============================================================

genus_slope_table <- genus_slope_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Genus_slope_CrI = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      Genus_slope,
      Genus_slope_lower,
      Genus_slope_upper
    ),

    Slope_difference_CrI = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      Slope_difference,
      Difference_lower,
      Difference_upper
    ),

    Probability_stronger_decline = round(
      Probability_stronger_decline, 3
    ),

    Probability_more_negative_slope = round(
      Probability_more_negative_slope, 3
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Trait,
    Genus,
    Global_slope,
    Genus_slope_CrI,
    Slope_difference_CrI,
    Probability_stronger_decline,
    Probability_more_negative_slope
  )

View(genus_slope_table)

```


# pH x SST interaction models
```{r}
traits <- c(
  "Biomineral",
  "ThicknessCT.um.",
  "Jaw_length",
  "SpineBiomineral",
  "Spine_diameter",
  "Spine_length"
)

temp_vals <- c(18, 23, 28)

dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    pH_z = as.numeric(scale(median_pH)),
    Temp_z = as.numeric(scale(median_temp)),
    TestDiameter_z = as.numeric(scale(TestDiameter))
  )

pH_temp_models <- list()

for(trait in traits){

 formula <- as.formula(
  paste0(trait, " ~ 1 +
         pH_z * Temp_z + scale(pH_var) +
         TestDiameter_z +
         (1 + pH_z || Genus) +
         (1 | Analogue/SitePair)")
)

  pH_temp_models[[trait]] <- brm(
    formula = formula,
    data = dat_all,
    iter = 4000,
    chains = 3,
    cores = 3,
    seed = 123,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99,
                   max_treedepth = 15)
  )
}

temp_vals_z <- (temp_vals - mean(dat_all$median_temp)) / sd(dat_all$median_temp)
testdiam_mean_z <- mean(dat_all$TestDiameter_z)

size_corrected_data <- list()

for(trait in traits){
  
  mod <- pH_temp_models[[trait]]
  

  beta_size <- fixef(mod)["TestDiameter_z","Estimate"]
  
  tmp <- dat_all %>%
    mutate(
      trait_value = .data[[trait]],
      trait_corr = trait_value - beta_size * TestDiameter_z
    )
  
  size_corrected_data[[trait]] <- tmp
}

trait_to_label <- c(
  Biomineral = "Predicted Test Biomineral (%)",
  ThicknessCT.um. = "Predicted Test Thickness (µm)",
  Jaw_length = "Predicted Jaw Length (mm)",
  SpineBiomineral = "Predicted Spine Biomineral (%)",
  Spine_diameter = "Predicted Spine Thickness (µm)",
  Spine_length = "Predicted Spine Length (mm)"
)

# ---- Plot ---- #

fitted_plots <- list()

for(trait in traits){

  mod <- pH_temp_models[[trait]]

  newdata <- expand.grid(
    pH_z = seq(min(dat_all$pH_z), max(dat_all$pH_z), length.out = 50),
    Temp_z = temp_vals_z,
    TestDiameter_z = testdiam_mean_z,
    pH_var = mean(dat_all$pH_var, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  fitted <- add_epred_draws(
    mod,
    newdata = newdata,
    re_formula = NA
  )

  fitted <- fitted %>%
    mutate(
      median_pH = pH_z * sd(dat_all$median_pH) + mean(dat_all$median_pH),
      median_temp = Temp_z * sd(dat_all$median_temp) + mean(dat_all$median_temp)
    )

  fitted_summary <- fitted %>%
    group_by(median_pH, median_temp) %>%
    median_hdci(.epred, .width = c(0.95, 0.5)) %>%
    ungroup()

  hd95 <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>% 
    select(
      median_pH, median_temp,
      hdi_95_low = .lower,
      hdi_95_high = .upper
    )

  hd50 <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.5) %>% 
    select(
      median_pH, median_temp,
      hdi_50_low = .lower,
      hdi_50_high = .upper
    )

  median_vals <- fitted_summary %>% 
    filter(.width == 0.95) %>% 
    select(median_pH, median_temp, median = .epred)

  plot_data <- median_vals %>%
    left_join(hd95, by = c("median_pH", "median_temp")) %>%
    left_join(hd50, by = c("median_pH", "median_temp")) %>%
    mutate(
      median_temp_label = factor(
        median_temp,
        levels = temp_vals,
        labels = paste0(temp_vals, "°C")
      )
    )

  overlay_data <- size_corrected_data[[trait]] %>%
    mutate(
      median_temp_label = factor(
        temp_vals[
          apply(abs(outer(median_temp, temp_vals, "-")), 1, which.min)
        ],
        levels = temp_vals,
        labels = paste0(temp_vals, "°C")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(median_temp_label %in% unique(plot_data$median_temp_label))

  y_label <- trait_to_label[[trait]]

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = median_pH, y = median)) +

    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = hdi_95_low, ymax = hdi_95_high,
          fill = median_temp_label),
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = hdi_50_low, ymax = hdi_50_high,
          fill = median_temp_label),
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(group = median_temp_label),
      color = "black",
      size = 1
    ) +

    geom_point(
      data = overlay_data,
      aes(x = median_pH, y = trait_corr,
          color = median_temp_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 2
    ) +

    facet_wrap(~ median_temp_label) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "18°C" = "lightblue",
      "23°C" = "orange",
      "28°C" = "red"
    )) +

    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "18°C" = "lightblue",
      "23°C" = "orange",
      "28°C" = "red"
    )) +

    labs(
      x = expression("pH"[T]),
      y = y_label
    ) +

    scale_x_reverse(
      limits = c(8.13, 7.53),
      breaks = seq(7.6, 8.0, by = 0.2),
      expand = c(0.02, 0.02)
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black",
        fill = NA,
        size = 1
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  fitted_plots[[trait]] <- p
  print(p)
}

combined_pH_temp_line_plot <- wrap_plots(fitted_plots, ncol = 3)
combined_pH_temp_line_plot

ggsave(
  "Figures/Supplementary/Combined_pH_temp_lineplots.svg",
  combined_pH_temp_line_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 8
)
```

# Extract posterior means
```{r}
# ============================================================
# EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS FOR ALL FIVE PREDICTORS
# MEDIAN pHT × TEMPERATURE MODELS, INCLUDING pHT VARIABILITY
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. DEFINE MODELS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

models_med_var_pH_temp <- list(
  "Test biomineral (%)" = pH_temp_models[["Biomineral"]],
  "Test thickness (µm)" = pH_temp_models[["ThicknessCT.um."]],
  "Jaw length (mm)" = pH_temp_models[["Jaw_length"]],
  "Spine biomineral (%)" = pH_temp_models[["SpineBiomineral"]],
  "Spine thickness (µm)" = pH_temp_models[["Spine_diameter"]],
  "Spine length (mm)" = pH_temp_models[["Spine_length"]]
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DEFINE MODEL PARAMETERS AND LABELS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parameters <- tibble(
  parameter = c(
    "b_TestDiameter_z",
    "b_pH_z",
    "b_Temp_z",
    "b_pH_z:Temp_z",
    "b_scalepH_var"
  ),

  predictor = c(
    "Test diameter",
    "Decreasing median pHT",
    "Median SST",
    "Decreasing median pHT × median SST",
    "pHT variability"
  ),

  reverse = c(
    FALSE,
    TRUE,
    FALSE,
    TRUE,
    FALSE
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. EXTRACT POSTERIOR DRAWS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_all_draws <- function(model, response_name) {

  draws <- as_draws_df(model)

  bind_rows(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(parameters)), function(i) {

      param <- parameters$parameter[i]

      effect <- draws[[param]]

      # Reverse median pHT and its interaction with SST
      # to represent decreasing median pHT
      if (parameters$reverse[i]) {
        effect <- -effect
      }

      tibble(
        response = response_name,
        predictor = parameters$predictor[i],
        effect = effect
      )

    })
  )
}


draws_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(models_med_var_pH_temp), function(response_name) {

    extract_all_draws(
      models_med_var_pH_temp[[response_name]],
      response_name
    )

  })
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. SUMMARISE POSTERIOR ESTIMATES
# Mean and 95% credible interval
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_table_med_var_pH_temp <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(predictor, response) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(effect),
    `2.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    `97.5%` = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CREATE WIDE TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_table_med_var_pH_temp_wide <- effects_table_med_var_pH_temp %>%

  mutate(
    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = c(
        "Test diameter",
        "Decreasing median pHT",
        "Median SST",
        "Decreasing median pHT × median SST",
        "pHT variability"
      )
    ),

    response = factor(
      response,
      levels = c(
        "Test biomineral (%)",
        "Test thickness (µm)",
        "Jaw length (mm)",
        "Spine biomineral (%)",
        "Spine thickness (µm)",
        "Spine length (mm)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = response,
    values_from = c(Mean, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
    names_glue = "{response}_{.value}"
  ) %>%

  arrange(predictor) %>%

  # Reorder columns by trait, with Mean, 2.5%, 97.5%
  select(
    predictor,

    `Test biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Test biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Test thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Test thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Jaw length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Jaw length (mm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine biomineral (%)_Mean`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_2.5%`,
    `Spine biomineral (%)_97.5%`,

    `Spine thickness (µm)_Mean`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine thickness (µm)_97.5%`,

    `Spine length (mm)_Mean`,
    `Spine length (mm)_2.5%`,
    `Spine length (mm)_97.5%`
  ) %>%

  # Round all estimates to 3 significant figures
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 3)
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. INSPECT TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

effects_table_med_var_pH_temp_wide


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. SAVE TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  effects_table_med_var_pH_temp_wide,
  "ResultsTables/effects_table_med_var_pH_temp_models.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


# pH variability summary plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)

# ==================================================
# 1. PREPARE DATA
# ==================================================

pH_variability_summary <- environmental_data %>%
  mutate(
    Site = factor(Site, levels = c("Extreme", "Reference"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      median_pH,
      pH_var,
      `perc_below_7.8`,
      Dur_events_h
    ),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "median_pH",
        "pH_var",
        "perc_below_7.8",
        "Dur_events_h"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "A) Median pHT",
        "B) pHT variability (IQR)",
        "C) Measurements below pHT 7.8 (%)",
        "D) Mean extreme-event duration (hours)"
      )
    )
  )

# ==================================================
# 2. PREPARE SHARED Y-AXIS LABELS
# ==================================================

analogue_order <- unique(environmental_data$Analogue)
n_analogues <- length(analogue_order)

pH_variability_summary <- pH_variability_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Analogue = factor(Analogue, levels = analogue_order),

    # One central position per analogue
    y_base = n_analogues - as.numeric(Analogue) + 1,

    # Slightly offset the two conditions
    y_position = case_when(
      Site == "Extreme" ~ y_base + 0.15,
      Site == "Reference" ~ y_base - 0.15
    )
  )

# ==================================================
# 3. CALCULATE COLOURS WITHIN EACH PANEL
# ==================================================

pH_variability_summary <- pH_variability_summary %>%
  group_by(Metric, Site) %>%
  mutate(
    value_scaled = {
      value_range <- range(Value, na.rm = TRUE)

      if (diff(value_range) == 0) {
        rep(0.5, n())
      } else {
        (Value - value_range[1]) / diff(value_range)
      }
    },
    point_colour = case_when(
      Site == "Extreme" ~ scales::col_numeric(
        palette = c("#F4A582", "#C92F2A", "#7F0000"),
        domain = c(0, 1)
      )(value_scaled),

      Site == "Reference" ~ scales::col_numeric(
        palette = c("#A6BDDB", "#3C5488", "#081D58"),
        domain = c(0, 1)
      )(value_scaled)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ==================================================
# 4. CREATE FOUR INDIVIDUAL PLOTS
# ==================================================

library(patchwork)

make_pH_plot <- function(metric_name, x_title) {

  plot_data <- pH_variability_summary %>%
    filter(Metric == metric_name)

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = Value, y = y_position)
  ) +

    geom_vline(
  xintercept = if (metric_name == "A) Median pHT") 7.4 else 0,
  colour = "black",
  linewidth = 0.5
) +

    # Dashed lollipop lines
    geom_segment(
  aes(
    x = if (metric_name == "A) Median pHT") 7.4 else 0,
    xend = Value,
    yend = y_position,
    colour = point_colour
  ),
  linewidth = 0.8,
  linetype = "dotdash",
  alpha = 0.9
) +

    # Circles at line endpoints
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = point_colour),
      size = 2.8
    ) +

    # Pre-calculated red and blue gradients
    scale_colour_identity(
      breaks = c("#7F0000", "#081D58"),
      labels = c("Extreme", "Reference"),
      name = "Site condition",
      guide = "legend"
    ) +

    # Analogue labels
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(n_analogues),
      labels = rev(analogue_order),
      limits = c(0.5, n_analogues + 0.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
  limits = if (metric_name == "A) Median pHT") {
    c(7.4, NA)
  } else {
    c(0, NA)
  },
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
) +

    labs(
      x = x_title,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 11,
        colour = "black",
        margin = margin(t = 12)
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 9,
        colour = "black"
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        colour = "black"
      ),

      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

      legend.position = "bottom",

      plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
    )
}


# ==================================================
# 5. GENERATE EACH PANEL
# ==================================================

pA <- make_pH_plot(
  "A) Median pHT",
  expression("Median pH"[T])
)

pB <- make_pH_plot(
  "B) pHT variability (IQR)",
  expression(pH[T] ~ IQR)
)

pC <- make_pH_plot(
  "C) Measurements below pHT 7.8 (%)",
  expression("% of measurements" ~ pH[T] < 7.8)
)

pD <- make_pH_plot(
  "D) Mean extreme-event duration (hours)",
  "Mean duration of extreme events (hours)"
)

# ==================================================
# 6. COMBINE WITH PATCHWORK
# ==================================================
pH_var_summ <- (
  pA + pB +
  pC + pD
) +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 2,
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(
        family = "sans",
        face = 2,
        size = 16,
        colour = "black"
      )
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


# ==================================================
# 7. DISPLAY
# ==================================================

print(pH_var_summ)

# ==================================================
# 8. SAVE FIGURE
# ==================================================

ggsave(
  "Figures/Supplementary/pH_exposure_metrics.svg",
  plot = pH_var_summ,
  width = 8,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)
```
